injuries.shortComment: Ryland went 2-for-2 on field-goal tries during Sunday's 34-6 loss to the Rams.
injuries.longComment: Ryland provided all of the offense for Arizona in Week 10, making multiple field goals in a contest for the fourth time in the last five weeks. The kicker has rebounded well in 2026 after a challenging 2025 campaign, converting 22 of 24 field-goal tries over 10 contests so for this season.

injuries.shortComment: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Burch (knee) will be sidelined for the rest of the 2026 season, Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Burch suffered an MCL injury to his left knee while on kickoff coverage in the first quarter of Sunday's 34-6 loss to the Rams. The second-year defensive end will end the 2025 campaign with 19 tackles (10 solo), including 1.0 sacks, across 10 regular-season games. Burch will turn his focus toward being fully healthy for the 2027 season, and his absence means Darius Robinson and Eku Leota will both take on more rotational snaps on the Cardinals' defensive line.

injuries.shortComment: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Wingard (wrist/hand) will be "out for an extended period of time," Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Wingard suffered wrist and hand injuries during the Cardinals' 34-6 loss to the Rams on Sunday, when he logged 11 tackles (six solo) and a pass defense. It's possible that the veteran defensive back goes on injured reserve, and in his absence, the Cardinals will turn to Dadrion Taylor-Demerson, Kitan Crawford or Kei'Trel Clark to fill in at safety alongside Budda Baker.

injuries.shortComment: Beck was 11-for-18 passing for 108 yards, no touchdowns and two interceptions and had one rush for one yard during Sunday's 34-6 loss to the Rams.
injuries.longComment: The Cardinals traded Jacoby Brissett to the Ravens after Week 8, and then Gardner Minshew tore the UCL in his right elbow in Week 9, setting the stage for the first appearance (a start) of Beck's career. Beck, a rookie third-rounder, generated just two drives of 30-plus yards among his nine possessions overall, and two others ended in interceptions in Rams territory. He also didn't find much success with his top available skill-position talent, TE Trey McBride, who gathered in all five of his targets for 37 yards. They'll look to improve their rapport next Sunday in Kansas City.

injuries.shortComment: Allgeier mustered five carries for 14 yards and didn't gather in his only target during Sunday's 34-6 defeat to the Rams.
injuries.longComment: With Bam Knight back in the lineup in Week 10 after one absence due to a concussion, Allgeier didn't reach double-digit touches for the first time since Week 5, a span in which the latter's 65 touches went for 334 yards from scrimmage and two total TDs. Knight himself found a similar lack of success Sunday with just 19 yards on his five rushes. Because the Cardinals racked up just 123 yards of offense in rookie QB Carson Beck's first NFL start, it's tough to envision worse outcomes moving forward, though the team does take on the surging Chiefs next Sunday on the road.

injuries.shortComment: McBride tallied five catches on as many targets for 37 yards during Sunday's 34-6 loss to the Rams.
injuries.longComment: McBride's streak of at least seven catches ended at 11 games, and his receiving yardage total marked his second-fewest of the campaign in what doubled as rookie QB Carson Beck's first NFL start. Better days likely are ahead for the duo, but as McBride works with his third signal-caller this season -- and the least experienced one at that after Jacoby Brissett and Gardner Minshew -- there may be more lows than highs for the tight end over the final seven contests. McBride will look to bounce back next Sunday at Kansas City.

injuries.shortComment: Williams (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Williams will end up missing a second consecutive game due to a knee injury, and his next opportunity to play is Week 11 against the Chiefs on Nov. 22. Josh Fryar will likely start at left tackle in Williams' absence.

injuries.shortComment: Lopez (toe/ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Rams, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Lopez injured his toe in Week 9 against the Seahawks, and he was also working through an ankle issue during Week 10 prep. The sixth-year pro went through pregame warmups, and medical staff gave Lopez the green light to play in Sunday's NFC West showdown. Lopez has accumulated 24 tackles (10 solo), including 1.0 sacks, and one pass defense through nine regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Long (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Rams, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Long was activated from injured reserve Saturday, and the sixth-year pro has been cleared to return from a five-game absence due to a knee injury. He will operate in a rotational role at tight end behind Trey McBride and Elijah Higgins.

injuries.shortComment: Aguilar (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the emergency third quarterback against the Rams on Sunday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: With Jacoby Brissett being traded to Baltimore on Nov. 6 and Gardner Minshew (elbow, IR) out for the rest of the season, the Cardinals overhauled their QB room by signing both Josh Johnson and Aguilar earlier this week, with Carson Beck now serving as the starter. As the emergency third quarterback, Aguilar is not allowed to play Sunday unless both Beck and Johnson leave the game due to injury, illness or ejection.

injuries.shortComment: Minshew suffered a torn UCL in his right throwing elbow last Sunday at Seattle and is slated to undergo season-ending surgery, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
injuries.longComment: Minshew incredibly played through the injury in Week 9, logging all 53 offensive snaps and completing 21 of 30 passes for 166 yards, no touchdowns and no interceptions in his first start replacing the since-departed Jacoby Brissett. Schefter added that Minshew still is determining the timing of the procedure, but he plans on having it. With Minshew out for the rest of the campaign, rookie third-round pick Carson Beck is taking over under center for the Cardinals.

injuries.shortComment: Carter (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Rams, Zach Gershman of the Cardinals' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Carter will remain on IR for Week 10 and will not suit up for Sunday's divisional contest against the Rams. The defensive tackle logged three consecutive limited practices after being designated to return from injured reserve Wednesday.

injuries.shortComment: Fehoko will take over a larger role after teammate Michael Wilson suffered a season-ending neck injury last week, Zach Gershman of the Cardinals' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Fehoko is a 2021 fifth-round pick who turned 29 earlier this month and has been targeted on just two of 37 routes for the Cardinals this year. He mostly seems to have stuck around the league because his size is useful for special teams and blocking, but Fehoko now has a chance to get more snaps on offense, if only because Arizona's WR depth chart has been decimated. He has a chance to start this Sunday against the Rams in QB Carson Beck's first career start.

injuries.shortComment: Virgil will take over a larger role after teammate Michael Wilson suffered a season-ending neck injury last week, Zach Gershman of the Cardinals' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: A 2026 fifth-round pick, Virgil started his career buried on the depth chart before moving up due to injuries and trades. It's not quite the same as earning a starting job, but he should see routes and targets all the same in the coming weeks. Virgil has been targeted on 11 of 56 routes (19.6 percent) and caught just three passes for 54 yards in five appearances. He should get plenty of playing time this Sunday against the Rams in what will be the first career start for rookie QB Carson Beck.

injuries.shortComment: Knight (concussion) is cleared to play Sunday against the Rams, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Knight figures to split backfield work with Tyler Allgeier, who played 96 percent of snaps last week when Knight was inactive for a 17-3 loss at Seattle. Knight suffered the concussion in Week 8, shortly after Jeremiyah Love injured his ankle -- an issue that sent the rookie to injured reserve not long after. Love is out for at least three more games, leaving Allgeier and Knight to split backfield work again.

injuries.shortComment: Higgins is signing a contract extension with the Cardinals through 2029, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Higgins was scheduled for free agency after this season, and he's taken on a larger role as the year has progressed, helping the Cardinals get by with limited talent at wide receiver. Higgins has 18 catches for 162 yards and a touchdown on 20 targets, serving as a complementary receiving option alongside Trey McBride when the Cardinals use multi-TE formations. Higgins figures to stick in that role long-term and won't be of much fantasy interest unless McBride misses time.

injuries.shortComment: Baker recorded 11 tackles (three solo) in Sunday's 17-3 loss to the Cardinals.
injuries.longComment: The star safety has now logged three 11-tackle games this season, and Baker remains one of the bright spots for a Cardinals team that doesn't have many in 2026. The 10th-year pro was mentioned in trade rumors prior to Tuesday's deadline, but he'll finish out the campaign in Arizona. He's up to 62 tackles (29 solo), including a career-high 3.5 sacks, four pass breakups, including an interception, and a forced fumble across nine starts this season. Baker appears headed for an eighth straight Pro Bowl selection.

injuries.shortComment: Hull failed to haul in his lone target during the Cardinals' 17-3 loss to the Seahawks on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Ten of Hull's 12 snaps came on special teams, and he wasn't bale to connect with Gardner Minshew on the latter's pass attempt early in the third quarter. Hull has yet to log a carry through three regular-season appearances with the Cardinals. However, he could operate as the team's RB2 behind Tyler Allgeier for Week 10 against the Rams if Bam Knight doesn't clear the league's concussion protocol for that contest.

injuries.shortComment: Moody went 2-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made his only PAT during Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Chiefs.
injuries.longComment: Moody was signed by the Falcons off the Ravens' practice squad Tuesday, and he was able to put together a perfect debut with the team in Week 10. The kicker converted a 28-yard field-goal try in the second quarter before later adding a 38-yard make in the fourth. With Atlanta's bye week in Week 11, Moody's next chance to build on Sunday's performance will come in Week 12 against the Vikings.

injuries.shortComment: Hooper recorded an eight-yard reception on his lone target in Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Chiefs.
injuries.longComment: Hooper was on the field for just 11 of the Falcons' 72 offensive snaps, with his 15 percent share placing him comfortably behind Kyle Pitts (76 percent) and Charlie Woerner (44 percent) among Atlanta tight ends. The 32-year-old Hooper hasn't played more than half of the snaps in any of Atlanta's first 10 games and has turned in a 10-84-1 receiving line on 12 targets, a level of production that keeps him well off the fantasy radar.

injuries.shortComment: Head coach Kevin Stefanski said Monday that London was cleared of a concussion near the end of Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Chiefs, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: London was checked for a possible concussion in the fourth quarter of Week 10 action, but the result of the evaluation wasn't reported before the game concluded. Prior to his exit Sunday, he posted his third 100-yard game (109, to be exact) of the campaign on six catches and a season-high 12 targets. London will continue to operate as the Falcons' No. 1 WR after a Week 11 bye in the team's next game Sunday, Nov. 29, at Minnesota.

injuries.shortComment: Penix completed 23 of 43 passes for 286 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and rushed four times for 29 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.
injuries.longComment: Penix struggled while the game was still in question, but he did manage to pad his stats some down the stretch as the Falcons unsuccessfully tried to overcome their deficit. Penix connected with eight different targets overall on the afternoon, and he ultimately finished with a season high in passing yards. Penix has now tossed six interceptions in the last three games, however, and he'll look to regroup during the Week 11 bye before tackling a difficult matchup against the Vikings on the road on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Pitts brought in four of five targets for 50 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
injuries.longComment: The veteran tight end had a slow start to the day before coming on when the Falcons went especially pass-heavy in the second half. Pitts' fumble, his first of the season, came with just over four minutes remaining in the game after the contest was out of reach, and his catch total was his highest since Week 7. Pitts remains a key complementary option in an Atlanta passing attack that's scuffled of late, and he'll look to bounce back after the Falcons emerge from a Week 11 bye with a Week 12 road matchup against the Vikings on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Robinson rushed 16 times for 71 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for six yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: The Falcons were down 14-3 by halftime and 21-3 doing into the final period, so Robinson's opportunities progressively dwindled due to game script. However, the star running back still averaged a solid 4.4 yards per carry and recorded his sixth rushing touchdown of the season on a three-yard run in the fourth quarter. Robinson has at least four receptions in three of the last four games, and he'll now have a Week 11 bye to rest up before a tough Week 12 road matchup against the Vikings on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Daniels (Achilles) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Daniels popped up on Thursday's practice report as a limited participant due to an Achilles injury, but his full session Friday was enough for him to avoid an injury tag for Sunday's home game. The rookie fourth-rounder has accumulated 61 tackles (41 solo), including 1.0 sacks, two pass defenses (including one interception) and one fumble recovery through nine regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Henderson and the Falcons agreed to a two-year contract extension Friday.
injuries.longComment: Per Ian Rapoport of ESPN and NFL Network, Henderson's extension is worth up to $20 million and includes $11 million guaranteed. Henderson has started at outside cornerback in each of his last six outings, and he was moved into the starting lineup after A.J. Terrell landed on injured reserve in late September due to a groin injury. Across eight regular-season games, Henderson has logged 41 tackles (32 solo), nine pass defenses, one forced fumble and one fumble recovery.

injuries.shortComment: Thomas and the Falcons agreed to a three-year extension worth up to $33 million Friday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
injuries.longComment: The extension means Thomas -- a third-round selection of the Cardinals in the 2022 NFL Draft -- will be under contract with the Falcons through the 2029 season. The fifth-year pro has stepped into a larger role defensively this year due to the absences of James Pearce (back) and Jalon Walker (knee, IR), the former of whom missed the first eight games of the 2026 campaign while serving a suspension for violating the league's personal conduct policy. Thomas has accumulated 25 tackles (nine solo), including 2.0 sacks, one pass defense and one forced fumble through nine regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Herbert carried the ball once for seven yards and caught two of his three targets for two yards during Atlanta's loss to the Bengals on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Herbert continued to serve a limited role in his first game since being signed to the active roster from the practice squad, as he played just 11 snaps on offense and nine on special teams. With Brian Robinson (hamstring) set to miss at least another three games, Herbert will likely continue to serve as the team's backup running back behind Bijan Robinson.

injuries.shortComment: Zaccheaus caught one of three targets for five yards during the Falcons' 34-17 loss to the Bengals on Sunday in Madrid. He also returned one kickoff for 28 yards and returned two punts for minus-three yards.
injuries.longComment: Zaccheaus briefly left Sunday's game and was evaluated for a possible concussion, but the veteran wide receiver was quickly cleared to return. He has only six catches (on 16 targets) for 26 yards through eight regular-season games, and he's caught one pass or zero in seven of those contests. Zaccheaus isn't a key piece in the Falcons' offense, and that's unlikely to change heading into Week 10 against the Chiefs on Nov. 15.

injuries.shortComment: Dotson caught two passes for 16 yards on two targets in Sunday's 34-17 loss to the Bengals.
injuries.longComment: Despite playing 84 percent of the offensive snaps, Dotson's two targets were a distant sixth on the team against Cincinnati. He has 16 catches for 33 yards and two touchdowns on 33 targets through nine games this season and isn't a particularly exciting fantasy option fighting for scraps behind Drake London, Bijan Robinson and Kyle Pitts in Atlanta.

injuries.shortComment: The Ravens traded Vorhees and a conditional 2028 sixth-round pick to the Falcons on Tuesday in exchange for Ryan Neuzil, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: The move gives the Falcons additional depth at the guard position behind starters Chris Lindstrom and Matthew Bergeron. Vorhees -- a seventh-round selection of the Ravens in the 2023 NFL Draft -- started in all 17 regular-season games in 2025, but he's started in only two of five contests this year. He also missed two games in October while recovering from a foot injury.

injuries.shortComment: Abdullah (hamstring) is active for Sunday's game versus the Bengals in Madrid, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Abdullah was placed on injured reserve Oct. 10 due to a hamstring injury, and after missing the required four games while on the list, he was designated to return Wednesday and then activated Saturday, setting him up for his first game action since Week 4. A rotational role off the edge is likely for Abdullah due to James Pearce (back) making his season debut and all of Cameron Thomas, Za'Darius Smith and Charles Snowden available to the defense.

injuries.shortComment: Madubuike (hamstring) has been ruled out for the remainder of Monday night's contest against the Chargers.
injuries.longComment: Madubuike suffered a hamstring injury in the second half, and his night has now officially come to a premature end. In his absence, Broderick Washington is a top candidate to see an increase in workload on Baltimore's defensive line versus Los Angeles.

injuries.shortComment: Ioane (shoulder) is questionable to return to Monday night's contest against the Chargers.
injuries.longComment: Ioane suffered a shoulder injury in the second half, and his status for the rest of the game is now up in the air. In his absence, Chuma Edoga has taken over as the Ravens' right guard versus Los Angeles.

injuries.shortComment: Slovis (coach's decision) is inactive but serving as the Ravens' emergency No. 3 quarterback Monday night versus the Chargers.
injuries.longComment: Slovis will operate as Baltimore's third option at QB for the second straight week. He will only be eligible to enter the game if both starter Jacoby Brissett and backup Joe Fagnano are removed from the contest.
