injuries.shortComment: Randall (neck/hamstring) wasn't activated from injured reserve and will remain out for Monday's game against the Chargers, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.
injuries.longComment: A rookie fifth-round pick out of Clemson, Randall is still waiting to make his NFL debut while he's spent all season on IR due to a neck injury. He had his 21-day evaluation window opened Oct. 28 and has been a full participant in practices each of the last three weeks, but the Ravens haven't elected to reinstate him. His window will come to a close Wednesday, so if he's not activated by then, the 22-year-old running back will remain on IR for the rest of the season.

injuries.shortComment: The Ravens elevated Vannett from the practice squad ahead of Monday's game against the Chargers.
injuries.longComment: Vannett will suit up for Baltimore on Monday after appearing in the last five games. Despite getting on the field in each of those contests, the 33-year-old hasn't recorded a catch.

injuries.shortComment: The Ravens elevated Moore from the practice squad ahead of Monday's game against the Chargers.
injuries.longComment: Moore will appear in his fifth game of the 2026 campaign. In his previous four outings this season, he has garnered three catches (six targets) for 63 yards and one touchdown.

injuries.shortComment: Bateman (calf) was listed as a full participant on Friday's practice estimation.
injuries.longComment: After being limited at practice Thursday, the starting wideout is in line to face the Chargers on Monday night after being deemed 'FP' on Friday. While Bateman has turned in two consecutive one-catch efforts, there's a chance that working with the team's new QB Jacoby Brissett could spark some added production for the 2021 first-rounder while working alongside top WR Zay Flowers.

injuries.shortComment: Jackson (thumb) is "doing well" and is expected to be out for "6-to-10 weeks," per head coach Jesse Minter.
injuries.longComment: Minter's statement confirmed previous reports that Jackson is both recovering from a "broken and dislocated thumb" and also that he is facing a recovery timeline of at least six weeks. It did not confirm that Jackson underwent surgery, but per Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com a procedure has been performed, and Jackson is not due back before Week 16. Jackson informed teammates earlier this month that he plans to return this season, but that will hinge on how his recovery progresses and presumably whether or not the Ravens are in playoff contention late in the campaign. Jacoby Brissett, who was recently acquired from the Cardinals, figures to hold down the starting quarterback spot in Jackson's absence.

injuries.shortComment: Hamilton (hip) practiced in full Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Hamilton suffered a hip injury during the Week 9 loss to Jacksonville and didn't finish the contest. Now, after logging a full practice Thursday, he is good to go for Monday's game against the Chargers, assuming he doesn't suffer a setback along the way. Hamilton has appeared in all nine games for Baltimore during the 2026 campaign, accumulating 60 total tackles (43 solo), one interception and four additional passes defended.

injuries.shortComment: Wiggins (illness) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Wiggins was inactive for the Week 9 meeting with the Jaguars. However, after logging a full practice session Thursday, it appears he is good to go for Week 10 against the Chargers. The 23-year-old has appeared in eight games this season, garnering 24 total tackles (17 solo) and four passes defensed.

injuries.shortComment: Patterson will be the Ravens' kicker for Monday night's game against the Chargers, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: The Ravens signed Harrison Mevis to their practice squad in addition to signing Patterson to the 53-man roster, but the team intends to utilize Patterson as the kicker for Monday's game. Patterson went 7-for-9 on field-goal attempts in five appearances with the Dolphins this season, with a long of just 41 yards. His career-long made field goal of 54 yards came with Miami last season.

injuries.shortComment: The Ravens acquired Neuzil from the Falcons on Tuesday in exchange for guard Andrew Vorhees and a conditional 2028 sixth-round pick, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Neuzil had started at center in each of the Falcons' first nine games of the season, but he's expected to fill a more versatile backup role in Baltimore, per Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic. In addition to center, Neuzil is capable of playing both guard spots, so he'll likely be the top candidate to start if Cam Jurgens, John Simpson or Vega Ioane misses time at any point.

injuries.shortComment: Ahead of Week 10, Ravens head coach Jesse Minter noted "I expect (Brissett) to be our starter" next Monday against the Chargers, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: Brissett officially landed with the Ravens in a trade with the Cardinals this past Friday, and he's now on track to assume his new team's starting QB role for the foreseeable future. As a result, Joe Fagnano -- who had a spot start in Week 9 -- will revert to backup status. With regard to franchise signal-caller Lamar Jackson (thumb), who currently is on IR, he's indicated that he plans to return later this season. However, he's out for at least three more games, and 4-5 Baltimore's record as the season progresses figures to factor into Jackson's approach to a potential return to action.

injuries.shortComment: Starks finished Baltimore's Week 9 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday with four tackles (three solo) and a forced fumble.
injuries.longComment: Starks tied for third on his team in tackles during a rather uninspiring performance on both offense and defense by the Ravens. He did make a big play when he forced a fumble that was recovered by Baltimore in the third quarter, but the Ravens turned the ball over on downs on four plays on their ensuing possession. Starks logged 84 tackles over 17 regular-season games as a rookie last year, and he's well on his way to surpassing that mark with 55 stops (including 1.0 sacks) through nine contests in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: Smith finished with eight tackles (two solo) in Thursday's Week 9 loss to Jacksonville.
injuries.longComment: Smith led his team in tackles on a night when Baltimore had a hard time slowing down the Jaguars' offense. Though he's been bothered by knee and foot issues in recent weeks, the veteran linebacker logged a 95 percent defensive snap share Thursday. Smith is well on his way to another triple-digit tackle campaign with 74 stops, including 2.0 sacks, along with an interception and two forced fumbles through nine contests.

injuries.shortComment: The Ravens aren't expected to deal Henry before Tuesday's trade deadline, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
injuries.longComment: With Baltimore sitting at 4-5 and having lost its top two QBs in Lamar Jackson (thumb) and Tyler Huntley (toe) for the foreseeable future and rest of the season, respectively, there has been speculation Henry may be available via trade, but the team has informed the running back that it doesn't intend to consider such a transaction. Instead, the Ravens have dealt for quarterback Jacoby Brissett from the Cardinals to help stabilize the offense, which may help Henry end his streak being held under 100 yards rushing at four contests. Overall, Henry has racked up 689 yards and eight touchdowns on 175 carries for a career-low 3.9 YPC in his nine appearances in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: Hibner logged one reception for five yards on two targets in Thursday's loss to Baltimore.
injuries.longComment: Hibner ranked second among Baltimore tight ends with 30 offensive snaps, just behind Mark Andrews (32). The former didn't do much with the opportunity, but it was a very quiet game for the Ravens' passing game as a whole, as starting QB Joe Fagnano threw for just 60 yards. Baltimore will likely have the recently acquired Jacoby Brissett starting behind center for the team's next game (Monday, Oct. 16 versus the Chargers), but Hibner has just six catches across eight contests this season, so he's not a viable fantasy option regardless of who is throwing him the ball.

injuries.shortComment: Lane did not draw a target Thursday in a loss to Jacksonville.
injuries.longComment: Lane logged 32 offensive snaps, third-most among Baltimore wideouts behind Zay Flowers (37) and Rashod Bateman (35). However, Lane failed to haul in a pass (and to even see a target) for the first time this season. That can be partly attributed to quarterback play, as Ravens starting QB Joe Fagnano threw for just 60 yards. Jacoby Brissett, who Baltimore recently traded for, will likely start behind center in Week 10 against the Chargers on Monday, Nov. 16, which would improve Lane's outlook to some degree. However, he's caught one or fewer passes in three of his five games so far this season, so Lane isn't a recommended fantasy play regardless of who is starting at QB for Baltimore.

injuries.shortComment: Cuevas didn't garner a target in Thursday night's 33-10 loss to the Jaguars.
injuries.longComment: Cuevas split time with nine snaps on both offense and special teams. This game marked the fourth time this season that the rookie had zero targets. Prior to Thursday night, the 23-year-old saw multiple targets in four straight games. He will likely have a similar role as the season continues.

injuries.shortComment: Walker didn't garner a target in Thursday night's 33-10 loss to the Jaguars.
injuries.longComment: Walker made little impact in Thursday night's loss, playing 15 offensive snaps behind Ja'Kobi Lane (32), Rashod Bateman (35) and Zay Flowers (37). Walker will likely see a similar role as the season progresses.

injuries.shortComment: Bass made his sole field-goal attempt and all four PATs in the Bills' 31-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Bass made a 37-yard field goal in the second quarter of Sunday's contest. The kicker continues his perfect streak, having made all 20 of his field-goal attempts so far in 2026, with three such conversions coming from beyond 50 yards.

injuries.shortComment: Knox caught one of his three targets for seven yards in the Bills' 31-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Knox continues to receive targets as the No. 2 tight end in the Bills offense. The 30-year-old has consistently struggled to bring in catchable balls over the past few contests but remains a valuable part of Buffalo's 13-personnel packages as a blocker and receiving threat. Knox played 41 offensive snaps in Sunday's game and was on the field for 72 percent of the Bills' offensive plays.

injuries.shortComment: Coleman caught one of three targets for 11 yards during Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Coleman failed to reel in multiple passes for the third time in the team's last five contests, and he played just 52 percent of the team's offensive snaps in the contest, his lowest percentage since Week 1. The wide receiver was briefly sidelined while being evaluated for a head injury before returning to the contest, which likely contributed to his lower workload. Coleman will continue to be an unpredictable fantasy option in Week 11 versus the Dolphins.

injuries.shortComment: Davis rushed three times for eight yards in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Davis has been held to single-digit rushing yards in eight of nine games this season and has now managed to rush for just 52 empty yards on 16 carries for the season. He's nothing more than a bench stash in fantasy should something happen to James Cook.

injuries.shortComment: Shakir caught two of three targets for 26 yards in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.
injuries.longComment: With Buffalo controlling this one most of the afternoon, Josh Allen attempted just 21 passes and completed only 11 on a day wind gusts played a factor. Shakir's 26 receiving yards were his fewest since Week 3. He's scored just one touchdown this season and has yet to hit 100 yards in a game all year, so the ceiling isn't that high for fantasy while the floor is what he produced Sunday. Shakir is more of fantasy WR4 in PPR-based formats.

injuries.shortComment: Kincaid caught two of three targets for 58 yards in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Kincaid contributed catches of four and 54 yards to finish second on the team in receiving yards behind DJ Moore (90). The 2023 first-round pick has seen his usage fluctuate throughout the campaign, as Kincaid has failed to exceed three targets on five occasions but has drawn at least six looks from Josh Allen in each of the other four games. Kincaid is making the most of his opportunities for a second consecutive regular season, averaging 11.9 yards per target in 2026 after leading all qualified TEs with 11.7 YPT in 2025. Next up for Kincaid is a Week 11 home game against the Dolphins.

injuries.shortComment: Moore caught four of six targets for 90 yards and a touchdown while rushing once for four yards in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Moore's 45-yard touchdown catch in the third quarter accounted for half of his team-high total in receiving yards. This was his most productive outing since Moore went for 100 yards and a TD in his Bills debut, and the veteran wide receiver has chipped in 216 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns in three games since returning from a shoulder injury. Josh Allen and James Cook continue to lead Buffalo's offense with their legs, but Moore has re-established himself as Allen's top target in the passing game heading into a Week 11 home game against the Dolphins.

injuries.shortComment: Allen completed 11 of 21 passes for 196 yards, one touchdown and one interception while rushing five times for five yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Allen scored one-yard rushing touchdowns in the first and third quarters, bringing his season total up to 11 rushing TDs. He added his 13th touchdown pass of the campaign on a 45-yard strike to DJ Moore later in the third quarter, and Allen's fourth-quarter interception on third-and-long was basically an arm punt. Heading into a Week 11 home game against the Dolphins, the star QB has accounted for multiple touchdowns in all but one outing this season.

injuries.shortComment: Cook rushed 18 times for 157 yards and a touchdown and didn't catch his only target in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Buffalo relied primarily on its ground game in the lopsided victory, as Cook's 74-yard touchdown run in the fourth quarter provided the cherry on top after a pair of one-yard Josh Allen rushing scores helped the Bills pull away. Cook extended his touchdown streak to eight games by scoring his ninth rushing TD over that span. He has topped 100 scrimmage yards in all but one game during the productive stretch, bouncing back effectively after being held to 69 scoreless yards by the Texans in the season opener. Cook has a nice opportunity to keep rolling in Week 11, when the 8-1 Bills host the 1-8 Dolphins.

injuries.shortComment: Williams (calf) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Williams sustained a calf injury in the fourth quarter of Sunday's contest. The linebacker logged nine tackles (five solo), including 1.0 sacks, and one pass defensed before leaving the game. Rookie linebacker Kaleb Elarms-Orr will likely finish the remainder of the contest at inside linebacker next to Terrel Bernard.

injuries.shortComment: Alford (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Alford sustained a concussion attempting to complete a one-handed interception in the endzone during the third quarter. The slot cornerback will not return to the contest, leaving Damar Hamlin and other defensive backs to fulfill his role for the remainder of the contest.

injuries.shortComment: Benford (groin) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Benford was cleared to play Sunday after recovering from a wrist injury, but he is now dealing with a groin issue, which will prevent him from playing for the rest of Week 10. Dee Alford (concussion) was ruled out, so the Bills' secondary will lean more heavily on the likes of Jordan Hancock, Maxwell Hairston and Damar Hamlin.

injuries.shortComment: Brown (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Brown is a somewhat surprising activation after he missed Week 8 with a back injury before injuring his ankle in Week 9. The right tackle is set to suit up Sunday despite missing both the Thursday and Friday practice sessions in Week 10 prep. With Dion Dawkins, Alec Anderson and Brown all returning, the Bills will field a full starting offensive line for the first time since before the Week 7 bye.

injuries.shortComment: Hancock (hamstring) is active for Sunday's game against the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Hancock was activated from injured reserve Saturday, and the second-year pro was officially cleared to return from a six-game absence due to a hamstring injury. His presence bolsters a Bills secondary that was strengthened by the acquisition of veteran safety Amani Hooker from the Titans on Tuesday.

injuries.shortComment: The Bills did not activate Shavers (knee) from the reserve/PUP list, and he will not be available for Sunday's game against the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Shavers drew the questionable tag for Sunday's game against the Jets after logging a trio of full practices during Week 10 prep. However, he was not activated from the PUP list before the 4:00 p.m. ET deadline Saturday, so he will have to wait at least one more week before making his 2026 debut. Shavers' next chance to play is Week 11 against the Dolphins on Sunday, Nov. 22.

injuries.shortComment: Anderson (ankle) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Anderson is all set to suit up as the starting left guard for Sunday's game. The Bills have gotten the entire left side of the offensive line back from injury after the team went without Anderson or Dion Dawkins for its Week 9 win over the Vikings.

injuries.shortComment: Dawkins (ribs) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Jets.
injuries.longComment: Dawkins missed the Bills' Week 9 win over the Vikings due to a rib injury. The star left tackle is all set to suit up against the Jets, while right tackle Spencer Brown (ankle) is listed as doubtful for the contest.

injuries.shortComment: Head coach Joe Brady confirmed Friday that Hooker will play Sunday against the Jets, Sal Capaccio of WGR Sports Radio 550 Buffalo reports.
injuries.longComment: Hooker was one of several players who changed teams before Tuesday's trade deadline, with the Titans sending the veteran safety and a 2027 fifth-round pick to the Bills in exchange for a 2027 second-round pick. Hooker's addition bolsters a Bills defense that ranks 29th in the NFL in passing yards allowed per game (238.8) this season. It's unclear whether he'll start alongside Cole Bishop immediately or operate in a rotational role in the secondary in his Bills debut.

injuries.shortComment: Fitzgerald made two of his three field-goal attempts and both PATs in the Panthers' 20-17 win over the Saints on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Fitzgerald's 54-yard field goal as time expired iced the game for the Panthers. The kicker made another field goal from 55 yards while also missing his first attempt of the night from 48 yards out. Fitzgerald moves to 15-for-17 on field-goal attempts and 18-for-23 on PATs so far during the 2026 regular season.

injuries.shortComment: The Panthers signed Wilson from the practice squad to the active roster Monday, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Wilson has started the last three games at cornerback as a practice squad elevation. Now that the 27-year-old is out of elevations, the Panthers have made room for him on the 53-man roster. Wilson is set to start Sunday's game against the Ravens at outside cornerback opposite Will Lee (hamstring) or Corey Thornton. The Panthers released linebacker Nick Hampton in a corresponding move.

injuries.shortComment: out
injuries.longComment: out

injuries.shortComment: out
injuries.longComment: out

injuries.shortComment: Waller caught two of four targets for 24 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints.
injuries.longComment: One week after his 8-90-1 receiving outburst, Waller came back to normalcy in the Panthers' three-man committee at tight end. Waller has big upside, but his ceiling games are difficult to predict. He's been held below 40 yards with no touchdowns in five of nine games this season. Waller will be a low-floor TE2 with upside for Week 11 against the Ravens.

injuries.shortComment: Coker failed to catch any of his four targets in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints.
injuries.longComment: While it looked like Coker was going to be in line for a breakout 2026 season after his 8-138-2 receiving performance in the Week 1 opener, Coker has been held to 23 catches for 255 yards and one touchdown over his last seven games. At this point, he can't be trusted in fantasy lineups until he shows something in the box score again. This was a pristine on-paper spot versus New Orleans in the dome, and next Sunday's home date against Baltimore won't be any easier.

injuries.shortComment: Young completed 17 of 30 passes for 200 yards without a touchdown or interception in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints. He added one rushing yard on his only carry.
injuries.longComment: Chuba Hubbard did most of the heavy lifting on offense for the Panthers, piling up 172 scrimmage yards and both the team's touchdowns. It's the first time this season Young failed to throw a TD, but it was also the first time since Week 6 he avoided committing a turnover. The fourth-year QB will take a 16:6 TD:INT through nine games into a Week 11 clash against the Ravens.

injuries.shortComment: McMillan caught three of seven targets for 35 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over New Orleans.
injuries.longComment: The seven targets led the Panthers on the afternoon, but the second-year wideout wasn't able to do much with them. The 35 yards were McMillan's lowest total since Week 3, and he'll take a 49-660-3 line on 78 targets through nine games into a Week 11 tilt against the Ravens.

injuries.shortComment: Hubbard carried the ball 27 times for 92 yards and two touchdowns and caught all five of his targets for 80 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints.
injuries.longComment: The 27-year-old RB kept the Panthers' offense afloat nearly single-handedly, as he set a new career high with 172 scrimmage yards while scoring both the team's TDs, on a two-yard run in the first quarter and a one-yard plunge in the fourth. Hubbard's 80 receiving yards were easily a new career high, topping the 3-57-0 line on three targets he recorded in Week 15 of the 2022 season against the Steelers. Over Hubbard's last six games, he surged to 697 scrimmage yards and six rushing touchdowns, and he'll look keep rolling in a Week 11 clash with the Ravens.

injuries.shortComment: Phillips (hamstring) is active against the Saints on Sunday, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Phillips has been cleared by medical staff to return from a three-game absence due to a hamstring injury. Prior to the injury, he accumulated 10 tackles (three solo), including 2.5 sacks, across five regular-season games. His return will bolster the Panthers' pass rush alongside Patrick Jones, Trevis Gipson and Princely Umanmielen.

injuries.shortComment: Legette (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Saints, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: After being activated from injured reserve Saturday but still being listed as questionable heading into Sunday, Legette has now officially been cleared to play for the first time since Week 2. Legette was a full participant in practice throughout Week 10 prep, so he could immediately step back in as the Panthers' No. 3 wideout, the role he held prior to succumbing to the knee injury.

injuries.shortComment: Christensen (hamstring) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Saints, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: Christensen drew the questionable tag for Sunday's game against the Saints after logging a trio of full practices. However, he's not quite ready to return from a hamstring injury, and his next chance to suit up is Week 11 against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 22.

injuries.shortComment: Jackson (groin) has been downgraded from doubtful to out for Sunday's game against the Saints, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: Jackson's 21-day practice window opened Wednesday, and he drew the doubtful tag for Sunday's game after logging a trio of limited sessions. He's not quite ready to return from a groin injury that landed him on IR in late September, and his next opportunity to suit up is Week 11 against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 22.

injuries.shortComment: Brooks (groin) has been downgraded from doubtful to out for Sunday's game against the Saints, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: Brooks ended Week 10 prep with back-to-back limited practices, but he was tagged as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Panthers. The third-year running back is not quite fully recovered from a groin injury that landed him on IR in late September, so his next chance to suit up is Week 11 against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 22. Trevor Etienne, AJ Dillon and Anthony Tyus will continue to operate in rotational backfield roles behind Chuba Hubbard while Brooks is sidelined.

injuries.shortComment: Lloyd posted eight tackles (five solo) and one pass defense during the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
injuries.longComment: Lloyd played every single defensive snap and co-led the Panthers in tackles with Tyrel Dodson. It was the fifth time this season that Lloyd has logged at least seven combined tackles, and the fifth-year pro is up to 54 stops (32 solo), including 2.0 sacks, four pass defenses (including one interception and a pick-six) across seven regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Lewis (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's walkthrough practice.
injuries.longComment: Lewis has missed the Panthers' last two games due to a knee injury, but his full session Wednesday indicates that he'll be available for Sunday's NFC South tilt against the Saints. His return gives the Panthers more depth at offensive guard behind starters Robert Hunt and Torricelli Simpkins.

injuries.shortComment: Metchie caught both of his targets for 40 yards Sunday in a loss to the Broncos.
injuries.longComment: Both of Metchie's receptions came in the second half -- he brought in a 15-yarder midway through the third quarter and added a 25-yarder near the end of the fourth. The latter catch took the ball down to Denver's nine-yard line and set up a Panthers touchdown, but Carolina ultimately was unable to complete the comeback. Metchie has been consistent but relatively unremarkable this season, logging either two or three receptions in six straight games but not surpassing Sunday's 40 yards in any of those contests.

injuries.shortComment: Evans caught both of his two targets for 20 yards during Sunday's 26-21 loss versus the Broncos.
injuries.longComment: For the third game in a row, Evans drew exactly two targets and caught both of them Sunday. With that said, he also again trailed in snaps at tight end (31) behind teammates Tommy Tremble (46) and Darren Waller (35), both of whom also drew more targets in Week 9. Evans' role in the Panthers' passing offense isn't big enough to warrant fantasy consideration in most formats going into a Week 10 matchup at New Orleans.

injuries.shortComment: Etienne carried the ball two times for seven yards and returned one punt for nine yards during Carolina'a loss Sunday to the Broncos.
injuries.longComment: Etienne once again saw limited action offensively, playing just seven snaps. The 2025 fourth-round pick was the only running back other than Chuba Hubbard to record a carry and should continue to serve as the team's No. 2 back while Jonathon Brooks remains sidelined due to an abdomen injury.

injuries.shortComment: Head coach Dave Canales plans to take "the next two days" to discuss Horn (quadriceps), Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Horn has had a productive NFL career, amassing 196 total tackles (139 solo), including 2.0 sacks, and 10 interceptions across 56 regular-season games over six seasons. He underwent surgery on his quad back in September. However, until Horn is back on the field or there is a more informative update, he should be considered week-to-week.

injuries.shortComment: Burden (concussion) was spotted participating in the Bears' unofficial practice session Monday, AllCHGO.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Burden was diagnosed with a concussion after making a late exit in the Bears' previous game Nov. 8 against the Buccaneers, but he appears to have made some progress through the five-step protocol since Chicago went on bye for Week 10. Though head coach Ben Johnson hasn't confirmed that Burden has cleared the protocol, if the wideout is deemed a full participant Wednesday in the Bears' first official practice of Week 11, it would be a strong sign that he's trending toward playing Sunday against the Saints.

injuries.shortComment: Monangai (toe/thumb) was spotted working out during Monday's unofficial practice and is eyeing a return to action Sunday against the Saints, Chris Emma of 104.3 The Score Chicago reports.
injuries.longComment: Monangai hasn't played since Week 4 while recovering from a bout with turf toe and a right thumb injury, but he appears to be gearing up for a return following the Bears' Week 10 bye. Chicago won't release its first Week 11 injury report until Wednesday, when it will be known whether Monangai has been cleared to practice as a full or limited participant. He'll presumably need to turn in at least one full practice this week to put himself on a path to play Sunday, when he would likely settle back into a complementary role behind starting running back D'Andre Swift.

injuries.shortComment: Johnson recorded three tackles (one solo) and a pick-six during the Bears' 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
injuries.longComment: In a game that featured seven turnovers between the two teams, Johnson's takeaway was arguably the most impactful of them all. He jumped in front of a Baker Mayfield pass intended for Cade Otton late in the third quarter, which Johnson returned 67 yards to the house for the second pick-six of his NFL career. The veteran defensive back is up to 27 tackles (21 solo), three pass defenses (including a pick-six) and one forced fumble through nine regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Lewis produced six tackles (three solo) and one interception during the Bears' 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
injuries.longComment: Lewis jumped in front of a Baker Mayfield pass intended for Tez Johnson late in the second quarter, although the Bears offense turned the ball over on the very next play. It was the first interception of the season for Lewis and second of his career. The veteran safety is up to 35 tackles (25 solo) and two pass defenses across eight regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Simmons recorded four tackles (three solo), including 1.0 sacks, and one pass defense during the Bears' 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
injuries.longComment: Simmons took down Baker Mayfield for a three-yard sack midway through the fourth quarter, which was one of four sacks that the Bears recorded in Week 9. Simmons has logged sacks in back-to-back games in his first two outings with the Bears, and for the regular season, he is up to 48 tackles (26 solo), including 6.0 sacks, six pass defenses, one forced fumble and one fumble recovery across nine games.

injuries.shortComment: Thomas hauled in one of his two targets for 13 yards and returned three kicks for 88 yards during Chicago's win versus Tampa Bay on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Thomas continues to see limited action offensively, playing just five snaps Sunday and no more than 15 on offense in any game this season, though he did manage to record his seventh reception of the season. The rookie third-round pick should continue to see the majority of his action come on special teams, and he's now amassed 715 kick-return yards across nine outings this season.

injuries.shortComment: Roush caught both of his two targets for 23 yards during Sunday's 27-24 win versus the Buccaneers.
injuries.longComment: Roush, who has been utilized heavily as a blocker through nine games, achieved a new career high in receiving yards in Week 9. Roush has been relatively efficient with his limited targets so far this season, but Colston Loveland should be expected to continue to handle a substantial majority of the Bears' pass-catching duties at tight end as long as he's available.

injuries.shortComment: Johnson recorded two tackles on special teams during the Bears' 27-24 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) was inactive for a fifth consecutive game, with Johnson operating as the Bears' RB2 behind D'Andre Swift in the Bears' four contests prior to Sunday against the Bucs. However, Johnson didn't play a single offensive snap against Tampa Bay; instead, it was Salvon Ahmed (five carries for 25 yards) who mixed into the backfield as Chicago's complementary piece to Swift. The Bears are on a bye for Week 10, with their next game taking place in Week 11 against the Lions on Sunday, Nov. 22. Johnson would have a narrow path to offensive relevancy if Monangai is cleared to return for that contest.

injuries.shortComment: Raymond caught four passes for 32 yards on seven targets in Sunday night's 27-24 win over the Bucs.
injuries.longComment: Raymond tied Rome Odunze for second on the team in targets behind Luther Burden (nine), but Burden was injured late in the fourth quarter. If he needs to miss any time, Raymond projects to see elevated snaps alongside Odunze and Colston Loveland. The good news for Burden is he'll have two weeks to heal up with the Bears headed into their bye in Week 10.

injuries.shortComment: Santos made both of his two field-goal attempts and converted all three of his extra-point tries during Sunday's 27-24 win versus the Buccaneers.
injuries.longComment: It was an up-and-down night for Chicago's offense Sunday, as it moved the ball relatively well but committed five turnovers. Nevertheless, Santos got an opportunity to win the game on the last play of regulation with a 38-yard field goal, and it looked good from the moment it left his foot. Following a bye in Week 10, the Bears will play host to the Saints in Week 11, at which point fantasy managers might want to confirm the weather forecast in Chicago before locking Santos back into their lineups.

injuries.shortComment: Loveland caught four of six targets for 54 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Buccaneers.
injuries.longComment: Loveland was quiet for most of the night but got free for a 38-yard catch in the final minute to set up Cairo Santos' game-winning 38-yard field goal on the game's final play. The 2025 first-round pick has recorded at least 54 receiving yards in five of the past six games, having bounced back from a slow start to his sophomore season during which Loveland compiled just 34 yards through three games. Loveland will try to keep building momentum in Week 11 against the Saints following Chicago's Week 10 bye.

injuries.shortComment: Odunze caught four of seven targets for 60 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Buccaneers.
injuries.longComment: Odunze bobbled what should have been an easy touchdown catch and failed to get down inbounds by the time he secured the ball, but he made amends two plays later with his first touchdown catch of the season to cap Chicago's opening drive from nine yards out. He had another critical drop later in the game but still finished second on the team behind Luther Burden (concussion) in targets, catches and receiving yards. Burden exited late in the game, and if Chicago's Week 10 bye doesn't provide the team's leading receiver enough time to clear concussion protocol, Odunze could get an uptick in opportunities in Week 11 against the Saints.

injuries.shortComment: Swift rushed 12 times for 31 yards and didn't catch his lone target in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Buccaneers.
injuries.longComment: Swift was bottled up by an elite Buccaneers run defense that came into Week 9 allowing a league-low 80 rushing yards per game. He nearly had a fumble in the fourth quarter but was ruled down by contact on a play that the Buccaneers unsuccessfully challenged. Swift's momentum came to an abrupt halt with this season-worst performance, as he failed to reach 70 scrimmage yards for the first time all season after racking up seven touchdowns in the preceding four games. After Chicago's Week 10 bye, Swift could be back to sharing the backfield with Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe), who hasn't played since Week 4 but recently returned to practice.

injuries.shortComment: Williams completed 22 of 37 passes for 279 yards, two touchdowns and four interceptions in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Buccaneers. He also rushed five times for 16 yards.
injuries.longComment: Williams looked unstoppable early, capping Chicago's two first-quarter drives with touchdown passes of nine yards to Rome Odunze and 56 yards to Luther Burden, the latter of whom later exited due to a concussion. The 2024 first overall pick cooled down after that, throwing three second-quarter interceptions en route to a career-worst four interceptions overall. Chicago's defense picked up the slack with a pick-six against Baker Mayfield, and Williams found Colston Loveland for a 38-yard gain to set up Cairo Santos' game-winning field goal on the game's final play. The Bears have reeled off four consecutive wins since Williams returned from a hamstring injury to improve to 7-2, and he didn't have a turnover in the previous three games prior to Sunday night's downturn. Williams will look to clean up the errors in Week 11 against the Saints following Chicago's Week 10 bye.

injuries.shortComment: Stevenson exited Sunday night's game against the Bucs with a hand injury and is questionable to return.
injuries.longComment: With Stevenson sidelined and Malik Muhammad (toe) inactive, Josh Blackwell and Clark Phillips will take on more defensive snaps alongside Jaylon Phillips and Kyler Gordon at cornerback for the Bears.

injuries.shortComment: Muhammad (toe) is inactive for Sunday night's contest against Tampa Bay.
injuries.longComment: Muhammad was expected to be able to return to action in Week 9, but the cornerback will now be forced to miss a second straight game while nursing a toe injury he suffered in Week 7. In his absence, Josh Blackwell is a top candidate to see an increase in opportunities at cornerback behind starters Jaylon Johnson and Tyrique Stevenson versus the Buccaneers.

injuries.shortComment: Keenum (coach's decision) is inactive but serving as the Bears' emergency No. 3 quarterback for Sunday Night Football versus the Buccaneers.
injuries.longComment: Keenum will once again operate as the team's emergency QB option in Week 9, making it four games in a row in that role. The 38-year-old will only be eligible to enter the game if both starter Caleb Williams and backup Tyson Bagent are forced out of the contest.

injuries.shortComment: Jarrett (groin) does not carry an official injury designation ahead of Sunday's game versus the Buccaneers.
injuries.longComment: After missing the Bears' walk-through practice Wednesday, Jarrett logged a limited practice Thursday and then upgraded again to a full practice Friday. He should start on the interior of the defensive line next to Jeffery Simmons again in Week 9.

injuries.shortComment: The Bears placed Scott (wrist) on injured reserve Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Scott will be required to miss at least the next four games. He's appeared in four contests this season, playing 65 snaps on special teams.

injuries.shortComment: The Bears placed Street (knee) on injured reserve Wednesday, Adam Jahns of AllCHGO.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Street was injured in Monday night's win over the Seahawks and had to be carted to the locker room. He's now expected to miss the remainder of the 2026 season. Fellow DT Grady Jarrett (groin) was also injured in Seattle, making the move for Jeffery Simmons that much more important for Chicago.

injuries.shortComment: Jones (knee) is out for the rest of the season, Brad Biggs of the Chicago Tribune reports.
injuries.longComment: Jones underwent right knee surgery Tuesday, and as a result, he will be forced to miss the remainder of the 2026 campaign. In his absence, Theo Benedet (shoulder) will continue to operate as the team's primary option at left tackle.

injuries.shortComment: McPherson made one of his two field-goal attempts and all five PATs in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: McPherson converted a 24-yard field-goal attempt on the first drive of the game. The kicker proceeded to miss a 43-yarder in the second quarter of the contest, though the miss did not end up mattering to the final result of the game. McPherson is now 13-for-14 on field-goal attempts and 33-for-33 on PATs over nine contests this season.

injuries.shortComment: Meyers caught both of his targets for 20 yards and a touchdown while also adding 58 yards as a kick returner during Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Steelers.
injuries.longComment: Meyers reeled in multiple passes for the third straight game, and he was able to secure his first score of the year in the second quarter on a 15-yard touchdown pass from Joe Burrow. The 26-year-old's 28 offensive snaps ranked fourth at wide receiver for Cincinnati behind Ja'Marr Chase (59), Tee Higgins (51) and Colbie Young (29). With Andrei Iosivas (thumb) nearing a return to action, Meyers may see a sharp drop in offensive opportunities in the near future.

injuries.shortComment: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor said that Higgins was held out late in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Steelers for workload-management purposes, Kelsey Conway of The Cincinnati Enquirer reports.
injuries.longComment: Higgins still logged 51 of the Bengals' 66 offensive snaps, clearing the 75-percent threshold for the fifth time in his last seven appearances. He finished the game with five catches (on six targets) for 66 yards, and he may have had a better receiving line had the game been closer. If Higgins is working through an injury, it will be known after the Bengals post their first Week 11 practice report Wednesday. Through nine outings on the season, Higgins has produced a 53-824-6 line on 73 targets.

injuries.shortComment: Perine turned six carries into 14 yards and a touchdown and hauled in all four of his targets for 25 yards during the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: It looked like Chase Brown found the end zone in the fourth quarter for his third score of the game, but replay assist revealed that his knee came down just short of the goal line. Perine came in on the next play and took the ball for a one-yard touchdown to extend the Bengals' lead to 38-10 following Evan MacPherson's successful extra-point try. It was Perine's third touchdown of the season and first since Week 7 against the Ravens, and over his last five games, he has turned 39 carries into 151 yards (3.9 YPC) and two touchdowns while adding seven catches on as many targets for 44 yards and a score. He'll continue to operate as the Bengals' RB2 behind Brown heading into Week 11 against the Commanders on Monday, Nov. 23.

injuries.shortComment: out
injuries.longComment: out

injuries.shortComment: Brooks carried three times for 12 yards while taking the field for three of the Bengals' 66 offensive snaps in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Steelers.
injuries.longComment: All three of Brooks' carries came during the Bengals' final possession of the fourth quarter, when the team had already built a sizable lead and opted to rest multiple key players, including top running back Chase Brown. Brooks has been active for all nine of the Bengals' games to date but has logged just six carries, all of which have come late in blowout victories. So long as Brown and Samaje Perine are both available, Brooks will continue to see limited playing time on offense.

injuries.shortComment: Gesicki caught one pass for nine yards in Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Steelers.
injuries.longComment: Gesicki caught six touchdowns in the first seven games of the season, but he's now produced just three grabs for 20 scoreless yards over the past two contests. The fluky touchdown rate was never going to hold up, and Joe Burrow funnels so many of his targets through Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins and Chase Brown that there isn't a whole lot more to go around to Cincinnati's ancillary weapons. Gesicki is a touchdown-or-bust fantasy option most weeks despite running a bunch of routes as the de facto slot receiver.

injuries.shortComment: Brown rushed 10 times for 44 yards and brought in eight of nine targets for 39 yards for two touchdowns in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Brown averaged a solid 4.4 yards per carry, but as is customary, his rushing opportunities were capped in a Bengals offense that typically takes a pass-heavy approach irrespective of game script. He still benefited from that philosophy, however, as he tied his second-highest reception total on the season while ending his seven-game touchdown drought by hitting paydirt twice. Brown will get another favorable opportunity to build on his production in Week 11, when the Bengals travel to D.C. for a matchup with the Commanders.

injuries.shortComment: Chase brought in 11 of 14 targets for 231 yards in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday night. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Cincinnati.
injuries.longComment: Chase posted one of his signature 200-yard performances, with Sunday night's qualifying as the fourth of his storied career and marking his third instance accomplishing it against an AFC North rival. Needless to say, all three components of Chase's receiving line led the Bengals by a wide margin on the night as well, and after failing to hit the century mark in yardage in any of the first six games of the season, the star wideout has recorded at least 141 receiving yards in three straight. Chase is now up to a 64-878-7 line on 87 targets across nine games heading into a Week 11 Monday night home road matchup against the Commanders on Nov. 23.

injuries.shortComment: Burrow completed 35 of 44 passes for 409 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions and added one rush for eight yards in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday night.
injuries.longComment: The latest installment in what is looking like an MVP-worthy campaign for Burrow included quite a milestone, as the 2020 first overall pick became the only other player in NFL history beside Peyton Manning in 2004 to score four-plus total touchdowns in five consecutive games. All of Burrow's scores Sunday night came through the air, as he connected with Drew Sample (three yards), Chase Brown (two, four yards) and Dohnte Meyers (15 yards) for his quartet of TD strikes. Burrow also found the bulk of his success when focusing on top wideout Ja'Marr Chase, who was responsible for 11 of Burrow's completions and 231 of his yards on 14 targets. Burrow has now exceeded 400 passing yards on three occasions this season, including twice in the last three games, heading into a Week 11 road matchup against the Commanders on Monday night, Nov. 23.

injuries.shortComment: Burks (groin) will not return to Sunday night's game against the Steelers, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Prior to leaving, Burks recorded a pair of solo tackles. He's primarily played on special teams this season. Jack Kiser will be in line for increased reps with Burks sidelined.

injuries.shortComment: Risner (knee) will not return to Sunday night's game against the Steelers.
injuries.longComment: The veteran right guard was injured in the first half, and with the Bengals already stomping Pittsburgh, there's no need to push Risner back out there. It'll remain to be seen if he's looking at a multigame absence. Jalen Rivers has replaced Risner on the offensive line.

injuries.shortComment: Hinton (illness) is inactive for Sunday's Week 10 matchup against the Steelers.
injuries.longComment: Hinton is dealing with an illness and was added to the Bengals' injury report Sunday morning. He's not feeling well enough to be able to play against Pittsburgh. Hinton's absence will lessen Cincinnati's depth on the offensive line.

injuries.shortComment: Iosivas (thumb) has been downgraded from doubtful to out for Sunday's game against the Steelers.
injuries.longComment: Iosivas was designated to return from injured reserve Wednesday, but he was tagged as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Steelers despite logging full practices Thursday and Friday. He'll remain on IR for at least one more game, and his next chance to play is Week 11 against the Commanders on Monday, Nov. 23.

injuries.shortComment: Turner (ankle) was a full participant at practice Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Turner was able to play through his ankle injury in Week 9 against the Falcons, and it now looks like it's behind him entirely. He projects to start at cornerback against a pass-heavy Steelers offense Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: The Bengals opened Parker's (undisclosed) 21-day practice window Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Parker was placed on injured reserve on cutdown day with a designation to return. It appears the 22-year-old has progressed through his undisclosed injury and could be a candidate to return soon. Should he suit up this season, the sixth-round rookie will likely serve in a depth role on the offensive line.

injuries.shortComment: The Bengals designated Davis (hamstring) to return from injured reserve Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Davis was placed on injured reserve in late September after suffering a hamstring injury in Week 3 against the Steelers. The Bengals now have 21 days to officially activate the 30-year-old for him to remain eligible to play this season.

injuries.shortComment: Cook registered 10 tackles (five solo) during the Bengals' win over the Falcons on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Cook had his most productive outing of the campaign, logging a season-high 10 tackles. The 2022 second-round pick will look to build on this performance and keep producing during the team's Week 10 matchup versus the Steelers.

injuries.shortComment: Carter compiled 10 tackles (two solo), an interception and a pass deflection during Cincinnati's win over the Falcons on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Carter had one of his most productive outings of the season during the victory, as he matched Bryan Cook for the most tackles on the team in addition to recording his first interception of the campaign. The 2025 fourth-round pick has racked up 68 tackles (28 solo), including 1.5 sacks, an interception and two forced fumbles across eight games this season and will look to keep producing next week versus the Steelers.

injuries.shortComment: Johnson (ankle) is listed as active Sunday against the Falcons in Madrid.
injuries.longComment: Johnson suffered an ankle injury last Sunday versus the Titans, and he subsequently followed a DNP/LP/FP practice regimen during Week 9 prep before getting a questionable designation ahead of Sunday's international matchup. Now that he's confirmed to be active, he should be good for his normal 20-30 percent weekly defensive snap share.

injuries.shortComment: Howell (wrist) was placed on injured reserve by the Bengals on Tuesday.
injuries.longComment: Howell suffered a right wrist injury during Sunday's overtime win against the Titans, and he will now be forced to miss at least four contests as a result. The defensive lineman has already undergone surgery, per Mike Petraglia of CLNSCincy.com, and in Howell's absence, Shemar Stewart will stand to see an increase in workload at defensive end.

injuries.shortComment: Szmyt made two of his three field-goal attempts and all three of his PATs in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Szmyt knocked through field goals from 49 yards and 26 yards in Sunday's contest. The kicker stumbled in the fourth quarter, missing a 54-yard attempt with 11:02 remaining that would've brought the game within a point.   Szmyt is now 21-for-24 on field-goal attempts and 15-for-16 on PATs over 10 regular-season contests in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: out
injuries.longComment: out

injuries.shortComment: McLaughlin was limited to one snap on offense and none on special teams in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
injuries.longComment: Since Week 7, McLaughlin has logged just three snaps on offense in the Browns' ensuing three games, but prior to Sunday, he still appeared to be in the mix for work on kickoff returns. However, Isaiah Bond and Malachi Corley have since taken over as the team's preferred kickoff returners, leaving McLaughlin without a role on special teams. McLaughlin will likely continue to see little use as Cleveland's No. 3 back behind Quinshon Judkins and Dylan Sampson.

injuries.shortComment: Sampson rushed four times for six yards and caught four of six targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
injuries.longComment: Sampson hardly carries the ball for Cleveland and is merely the pass-catching complement to Quinshon Judkins out of the backfield. Across five games this season, Sampson has rushed 19 times for 79  yards while adding 16 catches for 152 yards on 22 targets. He's playable in PPR fantasy leagues as a desperation RB2 option, particularly in games for which the Browns are projected to play from behind.

injuries.shortComment: Jeudy recorded two catches on four targets for 74 yards in a 27-24 victory over the Texans on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Jeudy boosted his final line considerably on a 65-yard connection with Deshaun Watson in the second period. Watson carried the ball into the end zone on the following snap to bring the Browns to within seven points. Jeudy's 74 receiving yards were a season-high mark, though he finished with two or fewer receptions for the third straight week. The veteran wideout is behind both WRs Denzel Boston and KC Concepcion, not to mention tight end Harold Fannin, in the pass-catcher pecking order, so he may need to rely on big plays to have a chance to make an impact for fantasy managers.

injuries.shortComment: Concepcion caught three of eight targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over Houston. He also gained six yards on one carry.
injuries.longComment: Concepcion finished second on the Browns in targets behind tight end Harold Fannin, who had nine. However, whereas Fannin was able to turn his looks into seven receptions and 91 yards, Concepcion posted a much more modest 3-21-0 line. The rookie wideout departed to the medical tent during the first half of the game due to an undisclosed issue, but he was able to quickly return. Concepcion hasn't put up prolific numbers this season, but he does have at least three receptions in eight of his 10 appearances. Cleveland is on bye in Week 11, so Concepcion will next suit up Sunday, Nov. 29, against Las Vegas.

injuries.shortComment: Boston caught just one pass for 16 yards on two targets in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
injuries.longComment: The rookie wideout entered play Sunday dealing with a toe injury and appeared to aggravate it versus Houston. At less than 100 percent health, Boston was unproductive in the box score and saw a microscopic five percent target share. After popping back up for 6-98-0 receiving last Sunday in New Orleans with Shedeur Sanders at quarterback, Boston reverted to his sluggish ways with Deshaun Watson in Week 10. Over his last four games with Watson, Boston has compiled 11 catches for 95 empty yards. Boston can't be trusted in fantasy lineups until he shows more consistency.

injuries.shortComment: Watson completed 25 of 40 passes for 312 yards with no touchdowns and one interception while adding eight rushes for 49 yards and a score in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that remained with Cleveland.
injuries.longComment: Watson helped the Browns overcome a 17-point first-half deficit, even though he didn't throw any touchdown passes for the fourth straight game. The veteran signal-caller did pile up the passing yardage against his old team, however, eclipsing 300 yards for the third straight game in the process. Watson also hit Harold Fannin with a critical 30-yard pass on his last pass attempt of the afternoon to set up Quinshon Judkins' game-winning rushing touchdown, and he'll next draw a highly favorable matchup against the Raiders in a Week 12 home matchup on Sunday, Nov. 29, following a Week 11 bye.

injuries.shortComment: Fannin brought in seven of nine targets for 91 yards in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Fannin led the Browns across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets, and his 30-yard grab on Cleveland's penultimate possession set up Quinshon Judkins' game-winning five-yard touchdown rush on the next play. Fannin's chemistry with Deshaun Watson has been outstanding, and the second-year tight end now has at least 91 receiving yards in three of the past four games. Fannin will remain a central figure in Cleveland's impressive air attack when the team returns to action in a home matchup against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 29, following a Week 11 bye.

injuries.shortComment: Judkins rushed 10 times for 38 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of five targets for 33 yards in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Judkins' rushing volume was at a season-low level, but the second-year back managed to record his fourth rushing touchdown of the campaign on a five-yard run with just under a minute remaining. That proved to be the game-winning score, and Judkins also mustered his second-highest receiving yardage tally of the campaign. The 2025 first-round pick is averaging just 3.4 yards per carry, however, so he remains far from efficient heading into a Week 11 bye ahead of a Week 12 home matchup against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Barnett (hamstring) has returned to Sunday's game against Houston, Scott Petrak of the Elyria Chronicle-Telegram reports.
injuries.longComment: Barnett left in the first quarter due to a hamstring injury, but the veteran defensive lineman was cleared by medical staff to return to Sunday's contest.

injuries.shortComment: The Browns placed Burton (calf) on injured reserve Saturday, Chris Easterling of the Akron Beacon Journal reports.
injuries.longComment: Burton was already ruled out for Sunday's game against the Texans due to a calf injury that he picked up against the Saints in Week 9. The injury is severe enough for him to warrant an extended absence, and since he's now on IR, Burton will be required to miss at least four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 15 against the Giants on Sunday, Dec. 20. Since the Browns do not have another fullback on the 53-man roster, the team will likely turn to tight ends Carsen Ryan, Zaire Mitchell-Paden and Blake Whiteheart to provide blocking out of the backfield, per Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com.

injuries.shortComment: The Browns signed Ryan off the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Chris Easterling of the Akron Beacon Journal reports.
injuries.longComment: The move corresponds with the Browns placing fullback Michael Burton (calf) on injured reserve. Ryan was a seventh-round selection of the Browns in the 2026 NFL Draft, and this is the second time in November that he has been signed to the 53-man roster. The rookie out of BYU has not seen a target through the first eight regular-season games of his NFL career, and he's expected to operate mostly on special teams while providing depth at tight end behind Harold Fannin and Blake Whiteheart.

injuries.shortComment: Williams (hamstring) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against Houston.
injuries.longComment: Williams has had his practice reps over the last couple of weeks limited while tending to a hamstring injury, but he has yet to miss a regular-season game, and that trend will continue for Sunday's home tilt. The veteran linebacker has accumulated 62 tackles (37 solo), including 1.0 sacks, three pass defenses and four forced fumbles through nine regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Schwesinger (wrist) does not have an injury designation against the Texans on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Schwesinger opened Week 10 prep with back-to-back limited practices while tending to a wrist injury, but his full session Friday was enough for the second-year linebacker to avoid an injury tag for Sunday's contest. Schwesinger's 89 total tackles through nine regular-season games are third-most in the NFL behind Alex Singleton (107) and Nakobe Dean (99).

injuries.shortComment: Ward (quadriceps) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Texans.
injuries.longComment: Ward was managing a quad injury during all of Week 10 prep, but he avoided an injury tag for Sunday's game despite not logging a full practice. The veteran defensive back has 34 tackles (19 solo), nine pass defenses (including three interceptions) and two forced fumbles through nine regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Aubrey made both of his field-goal attempts and went 2-for-3 on extra-point tries during the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Aubrey connected on 52-yard field goals in both the first and third quarters, although his PAT in the second missed wide left. It was the second missed extra-point try of the season for Aubrey and his seventh miss overall, although five of those failed kicks have come on field-goal attempts from 50-plus yards. The Cowboys will stay home for Week 11 against the Titans, who give up 26.6 points per game (27th in the NFL) and have yielded 40-plus points in each of their last two contests.

injuries.shortComment: Abanikanda reverted to the Cowboys' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
injuries.longComment: Abanikanda made his 2026 regular-season debut against the 49ers in Week 10, when he operated as the Cowboys' RB2 behind Javonte Williams. Abanikanda finished that contest with two carries for eight yards and a two-yard catch on his lone target in what ended as a 46-40 loss for Dallas. With both Tyler Goodson (knee) and Malik Davis (hip) on injured reserve, Abanikanda figures to be elevated to the Cowboys' active roster for Week 11 against the Titans on Nov. 22.

injuries.shortComment: Bland sustained a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's 46-40 loss to the 49ers, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Bland will likely miss time after suffering a high-ankle sprain in Week 10 against the 49ers. It's unclear how much time he'll be sidelined, but the injury could be related to an issue that plagued Bland during the practice week. Cobie Durant will likely fill in for Bland should the standout cornerback miss any time.

injuries.shortComment: Booker suffered a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's 46-40 loss to the 49ers, Calvin Watkins of The Dallas Morning News  reports.
injuries.longComment: Booker is expected to miss multiple weeks after injuring his ankle in the first half of Sunday's game against the 49ers, per Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com. The 22-year-old may be able to avoid being placed on injured reserve with the Cowboys' bye coming in Week 14. T.J. Bass will likely slot into Booker's right guard spot.

injuries.shortComment: Williams rushed 16 times for 63 yards and brought in his only target for four yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Williams had a near monopoly on the Cowboys' running back touches, but he worked hard for everything he got against a talented 49ers front seven. The veteran back averaged under 4.0 yards per carry for the seventh time this season, but he did eclipse 60 rushing yards for the third time in the last four games. Williams will take 692 rushing yards and nine rush TDs -- along with a 25-131-1 receiving line -- into a Week 11 home matchup against the Titans next Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Lamb secured seven of 13 targets for 72 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Despite his own impressive numbers, Lamb played second fiddle to George Pickens for a change, as the latter doubled up the former in receptions and did the same with a yard to spare in receiving yards. Nevertheless, Lamb still put together a solid performance that included his eighth touchdown reception of the season, a spectacular leaping one-handed one-yard grab late in the fourth quarter. Lamb now is up to five consecutive double-digit target tallies and has at least 70 receiving yards in four of the last five contests heading into a Week 11 home matchup against the vulnerable Titans defense.

injuries.shortComment: Prescott completed 30 of 51 passes for 343 yards with five touchdowns and one interception while rushing four times for seven yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday. He also ran for a two-point conversion.
injuries.longComment: Playing catch-up from the second quarter on did wonders for Prescott's fantasy production, as the veteran quarterback sent 38 total targets in the direction of the talented trio of George Pickens, CeeDee Lamb and Ryan Flournoy alone. Prescott connected with Pickens for three of his scoring strikes, which went for 35, 39 and five yards. Flournoy (11 yards) and Lamb (one yard) accounted for the final two in the fourth quarter, and Prescott added a two-point conversion run after the final scoring toss with an admirable diving attempt on which he made contact with the pylon with the extended ball. Prescott tied a career high with his TD pass total, while his passing yardage was a season high. He should have an opportunity to put together a successful encore next Sunday, as a Week 11 home matchup with the vulnerable Titans secondary awaits.

injuries.shortComment: Pickens brought in 11 of 18 targets for 145 yards and three touchdowns in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: After watching fellow wideout CeeDee Lamb have several monster performances through the first half of the season, Pickens stepped up and took his turn in his return from a one-game absence due to a hamstring injury. Pickens was peppered with targets from Dak Prescott all afternoon, and the star receiver finished with career-high reception and target totals and a season high in receiving yards. Pickens struck from 35, 39 and five yards out on his trio of scoring grabs, which constituted Dak Prescott's first three TD passes on the day. A now clearly healthy Pickens is up to a 50-678-5 line on 80 targets for the season heading into a Week 11 home matchup against the Titans next Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Flournoy tallied six catches for 71 yards and one touchdown on seven targets during Sunday's loss to San Francisco. He also recovered a fumble.
injuries.longComment: Dallas played catch-up for much of the second half in the offensive slugfest, so quarterback Dak Prescott took to the air 51 times. Flournoy got seven of those targets, finishing third on the team behind George Pickens (18) and CeeDee Lamb (13). Flournoy's six receptions and 71 yards were both his second-highest figures so far this season, and the TD was his third in the past five weeks. That last stat in particular gives him relevance in most fantasy leagues, especially in matchups during which Prescott is expected to air it out often. The Cowboys will seek a much-needed win next Sunday at home against Tennessee.

injuries.shortComment: Ogbonnia (finger) has re-entered Sunday's matchup against San Francisco, Joe Hoyt of The Dallas Morning News reports.
injuries.longComment: Ogbonnia suffered a finger injury in the second quarter and was subsequently deemed questionable to return. However, he was able to get back on the field after halftime. Ogbonnia will thus continue to play a key role along Dallas' defensive line.

injuries.shortComment: Bullard (calf) is active for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: The Cowboys activated Bullard from injured reserve Saturday. The defensive tackle has been sidelined since sustaining a calf injury during the Cowboys' Week 3 loss to the Ravens. Bullard is set to suit up as a rotational defensive lineman behind starter Otito Ogbonnia.

injuries.shortComment: Porter (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Porter upgraded to limited participation in Friday's practice after missing the first two Week 10 prep sessions and the Cowboys' Week 9 win over the Colts. The cornerback is all set to return to the field alongside DaRon Bland to anchor the Cowboys' secondary for a big matchup with one of the NFC's top contenders.

injuries.shortComment: The Cowboys signed Mitchell from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Tommy Yarrish of the team's official site reports.
injuries.longComment: The Cowboys technically still have one elevation to use on Mitchell this season, but they instead will opt to sign him to the active roster for Week 10. His signing gives the Cowboys extra depth at tight end, as the team will be without Jake Ferguson (knee) for Sunday's game against the 49ers.

injuries.shortComment: The Cowboys placed Goodson (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Tommy Yarrish of the team's official site reports.
injuries.longComment: The move comes as no surprise, seeing as Goodson is expected to miss multiple games due to ACL and MCL sprains in his knee that he suffered during the Cowboys' Week 9 victory over the Colts. With Malik Davis (hip, IR) out for the year and Goodson now on IR, Israel Abanikanda -- who was elevated from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday -- will serve as Dallas' RB2 behind Javonte Williams for Sunday's game against the 49ers. Goodson is required to miss at least four games while on IR, so his next chance to play is Week 15 against the Rams on Sunday, Dec. 20.

injuries.shortComment: Turpin (ribs) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the 49ers, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Turpin has missed the Cowboys' last three games while recovering from a rib injury that he suffered in Week 6 against the Packers. His return will bolster Dallas' special teams, as he is the top returner on kickoffs and punts, and he'll also give the offense a boost as an explosive playmaker.

injuries.shortComment: Overshown (hamstring/back) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Jon Machota of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: Overshown didn't play in the Week 9 win over the Colts. He was limited in Wednesday's practice, though after logging a full session Thursday, he is good to go for Sunday's meeting with the 49ers. The 26-year-old has appeared in only three games during the 2026 campaign, amassing 20 total tackles (eight solo) and one interception.

injuries.shortComment: Downs recorded three tackles (two solo), including 1.0 sacks, and two pass breakups, including an interception, in Sunday's 27-23 win over the Colts.
injuries.longComment: Squaring off with his older brother Josh Downs on the opposite side, Downs recorded his first career interception on the Colts' final offensive play of the game with 41 seconds left in the fourth quarter. On a pass intended for Keenan Allen, Downs picked off Daniel Jones to seal the four-point win. The first-round rookie Downs now has 55 tackles (32 solo), including 2.0 sacks, three pass breakups, with the interception, and a pair of forced fumbles on 93 percent of the defensive snaps across nine starts this season.

injuries.shortComment: Singleton recorded six tackles (two solo) during the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
injuries.longComment: Singleton's six stops were a season low, but he still finished second on the Broncos in that category behind Jahdae Barron (eight). It's been a career year for Singleton, who is up to an NFL-leading 107 total tackles through nine regular-season games, which includes 2.0 sacks.

injuries.shortComment: Trautman caught two of three passes for 15 yards during the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Trautman failed to record a catch across six games between Weeks 2 and 7, but he has logged two receptions in each of his two outings. His 41 offensive snaps ended up being ahead of fellow tight end Evan Engram (38), although the latter has been more involved in the Broncos' offensive game plan than Trautman. The Broncos' next game takes place in Week 11 against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 22.

injuries.shortComment: Mims caught one of two targets for zero yards, added a five-yard carry and returned three punts for 22 yards during the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Nineteen of Mims' 24 snaps came on offense, although he logged only two touches in the process. He hasn't seen more than four targets in a game this season, with most of his output coming on special teams as a returner on both kickoffs and punts. The Broncos are on a bye for Week 10, so their next game will take place in Week 11 against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 22

injuries.shortComment: Franklin brought in three of four targets for 31 yards during the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Franklin drew a 27-yard pass interference penalty on the Broncos' second offensive play of the game, but the third-year wide receiver didn't log his first catch until early in the fourth quarter. He has operated in a rotational role for most of the season, and even with Jaylen Waddle in the league's concussion protocol, Franklin will likely maintain that workload following the Broncos' Week 10 bye.

injuries.shortComment: Engram caught four of five targets for 33 yards in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers.
injuries.longComment: The four catches matched Engram's season high, and his 33 yards were his most since Week 5. It goes without saying, but Engram is well off the fantasy radar at tight end. He has 17 catches for 169 yards and one touchdown through nine games, averaging a career-low 18.8 yards per contest.

injuries.shortComment: Lutz went 2-for-2 on both his field-goal attempts and extra-point tries during Denver's win over Carolina on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Lutz's field-goal tries were good from 26 and 48 yards. The 32-year-old has now converted 16 of his 19 field-goal attempts and all 16 of his extra-point tries across nine appearances this season.
