injuries.shortComment: Dobbins rushed four times for 18 yards and caught his only target for four yards during Sunday's 26-21 win over Carolina.
injuries.longComment: Dobbins saw 13 fewer carries than rookie running back Jonah Coleman (17-57-1) in the game. The four rushes were a season low for Dobbins, and he figures to continue to operate as the team's No. 2 option in the backfield moving forward.

injuries.shortComment: Bryant caught four of five targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 win over Carolina.
injuries.longComment: Bryant was activated from IR on Saturday after recovering from an ankle injury, and he came up big late in Sunday's contest, hauling in a 26-yard TD strike from Bo Nix with less than six minutes left in the fourth quarter for what proved to be the game-winning score. The second-year wideout's clutch play came after Jaylen Waddle (concussion) had left the game, and if a Week 10 bye doesn't give him enough time to recover, Bryant could see an elevated role in Week 11 against the Raiders.

injuries.shortComment: Sutton caught five of nine targets for 45 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers.
injuries.longComment: The five grabs and nine targets led the Broncos on the day, but Pat Bryant just edged him out for the receiving yards lead. The highlight of Sutton's solid performance was a three-yard TD from Bo Nix in the first quarter, as none of his receptions went for longer than 12 yards. Denver gets a well-timed bye in Week 10, but if Jaylen Waddle (concussion) isn't cleared to play on the other side of it, Sutton could see bigger volume in Week 11 against the Raiders. On the season, the long-time Bronco sports a 25-266-2 line on 46 targets through nine games.

injuries.shortComment: Coleman carried the ball 17 times for 57 yards and a touchdown and caught all four of his targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers.
injuries.longComment: The rookie has seized control of the lead-back role for the Broncos, with his 21 touches dwarfing J.K. Dobbins' five, and Coleman's nine-yard TD run early in the fourth quarter put his team in the lead for good. Coleman has piled up 261 scrimmage yards and two rushing touchdowns over the last three games, and there's no reason to think his role will shrink on the other side of a Week 10 bye.

injuries.shortComment: Nix completed 25 of 37 passes for 237 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers. He added two rushing yards on five carries.
injuries.longComment: The Broncos had the home team right where they wanted them heading into the fourth quarter -- holding a lead -- and Nix worked his usual magic over the final 15 minutes, leading back-to-back touchdown drives capped by a nine-yard TD run from Jonah Coleman and a 26-yard strike to Pat Bryant for what proved to be the winning score. Nix did throw his first INT since Week 3 in the win, but he heads into a Week 10 bye with Denver riding a five-game win streak that has taken it to the top of the AFC West.

injuries.shortComment: Waddle (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Panthers, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.
injuries.longComment: After being evaluated for a potential concussion, Waddle is done for the day and will thus target a potential return to action Nov. 22 against the Raiders, following Denver's Week 10 bye. In his absence Sunday, Courtland Sutton, Pat Bryant, Troy Franklin and Marvin Mims will handle the team's WR duties versus Carolina.

injuries.shortComment: Moss (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Panthers, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.
injuries.longComment: Moss has enterted the NFL's five-step concussion protocol and will not return to Sunday's game. Jahdae Barron will likely finish the game at outside cornerback for the Broncos.

injuries.shortComment: Tillman is active for Sunday's game against the Panthers, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Tillman was on the injury report ahead of the Week 9 meeting with Carolina due to a hamstring issue. However, he will avoid his second absence of the 2026 campaign. The 28-year-old has appeared in seven games for the Broncos this season, amassing 19 total tackles (10 solo).

injuries.shortComment: The Broncos placed Uwazurike (shoulder) on injured reserve Saturday, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Uwazurike wasn't able to practice at all this week due to a shoulder issue. He started seven of Denver's first eight games, but he's now required to miss the team's next four contests. Third-round rookie Tyler Onyedim could see the first gameday action of his career as a result.

injuries.shortComment: Tests have confirmed that Hutchinson suffered a torn ACL in his right knee during Sunday's win against the Patriots in Munich, but there's no other significant damage in the knee, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.
injuries.longComment: Hutchinson hurt himself on the first possession of Sunday's game after sacking New England QB Drake Maye, after which he went to the locker room and eventually was ruled out. Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported Monday morning that initial testing revealed the extent of the injury, which now has been confirmed. Hutchinson will turn his focus to getting healthy for 2027, though considering the timing of the ACL tear, he may be in danger of doing so by Week 1.

injuries.shortComment: LaPorta caught one of four targets for 16 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munch.
injuries.longComment: The Lions didn't need to throw it much, as Drake Maye (ankle) got knocked out of the game for the Patriots early, and LaPorta simply didn't get many chances to make an impact. It was the worst performance of the season for the fourth-year tight end, but LaPorta's gone four straight games without reaching 40 receiving yards or getting into the end zone. He'll try to break out in Week 11 against the Buccaneers.

injuries.shortComment: Williams caught four of seven targets for 50 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich.
injuries.longComment: Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs monopolized the Lions' offense on the day, scoring four of the team's five TDs, and there wasn't much production left over for Williams. The fifth-year wideout has topped 50 receiving yards just three times this season, and he'll take a 32-518-5 line on 51 targets through nine games into a Week 11 battle with the Buccaneers.

injuries.shortComment: St. Brown caught four of five targets for 98 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich.
injuries.longComment: The Lions didn't need to throw it much, as Drake Maye (ankle) got knocked out of the game for the Patriots early. St. Brown took full advantage of the volume he saw however, scoring on a 56-yard catch and run in the first quarter and then taking another short pass from Jared Goff and turning it into a 28-yard TD in the third. It was St. Brown's third multi-TD game of the season but his first since Week 2, and he'll take a 65-755-7 line on 91 targets through nine games into a Week 11 clash with the Buccaneers.

injuries.shortComment: Bates made all five of his PATs in the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots on Sunday in Munich.
injuries.longComment: Bates did not attempt a field goal in the contest. He remains 16-for-17 on field-goal attempts and moves to 29-for-29 on PATs through nine regular-season games in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: TeSlaa caught two of five targets for 19 yards and a touchdown during the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots on Sunday in Munich. He also recorded a tackle.
injuries.longComment: It was a quiet day for TeSlaa, with the Lions' offense being powered by usual suspects Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs, with the latter duo combining for four touchdowns (three receiving, one rushing). TeSlaa was the other Lions player to find the end zone, which took place early in the second quarter on a 12-yard touchdown pass from Jared Goff. It was the first touchdown catch of the season for TeSlaa, who found the end zone six times across 17 regular-season games during his rookie campaign in 2025. He has been the Lions' distant WR3 behind St. Brown and Jameson Williams, and that shouldn't change ahead of the team's Week 11 tilt against the Buccaneers on Nov. 22.

injuries.shortComment: Vaki turned six carries into 28 yards and added a 17-yard catch on his only target during the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots on Sunday in Munich.
injuries.longComment: Lead back Jahmyr Gibbs dominated with 252 yards and three touchdowns on 29 total touches (22 carries, seven catches on eight targets), but Vaki also had his moments during Sunday's game, including a 17-yard catch on the first play of the second quarter. Vaki was working through an ankle issue during Week 10 prep before being cleared to play, and he'll continue to operate in a rotational role in the backfield behind Gibbs. Through eight regular-season games, Vaki has turned 36 carries into 163 yards (4.5 YPC) and eight catches on nine targets for 81 yards. The Lions will be at home for three of their next four games, starting with Week 11 against the Buccaneers on Nov. 22.

injuries.shortComment: Gibbs carried the ball 22 times for 153 yards and two touchdowns while catching seven of eight targets for 99 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots.
injuries.longComment: Drake Maye (ankle) got knocked out of the game early for New England, setting the stage for the rout, and Gibbs took full advantage as he set new season highs in receiving yards and scrimmage yards. It's the fourth time in 2026 that the star RB has topped 150 rushing yards, and his fourth game with multiple TDs. Gibbs has amassed 1,384 scrimmage yards and 13 total touchdowns through nine contests as he gets ready to face a stingy Buccaneers run defense in Week 11.

injuries.shortComment: Goff completed 20 of 31 passes for 303 yards and three touchdowns with two interceptions in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich. He added three yards on his only carry.
injuries.longComment: A potential barn burner versus Drake Maye never materialized when the New England quarterback left the game early with an ankle injury, but Goff and the Detroit offense still held up their end of the bargain. Two of Goff's TDs went to Amon-Ra St. Brown, including a 56-yard catch-and-run score in the first quarter, while Isaac TeSlaa also hauled in a 12-yard score in the second. Goff will take an 18:4 TD:INT through nine games into a Week 11 clash at home against the Buccaneers.

injuries.shortComment: Wonnum (concussion) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Patriots in Munich, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.
injuries.longComment: Wonnum entered the league's concussion protocol during the Lions' Week 8 win over the Vikings. He was held out of Detroit's Week 9 win over Miami, but Wonnum has cleared protocol after passing an evaluation by an independent neurologist. His return bolsters the Lions' rotational depth on the defensive line alongside Aidan Hutchinson, Tyler Lacy and Derrick Moore.

injuries.shortComment: Branch (hip) was a full participant in practice Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Branch upgraded his practice status to full participation after beginning the week limited. The 25-year-old has 14 tackles (seven solo) and one interception in three regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Joseph (knee) did not travel to Munich with the Lions and is ruled out for Sunday's matchup against the Patriots.
injuries.longComment: Joseph was a full participant in practice Thursday, but it appears the Lions are taking a cautious approach to his return. The 25-year-old has one more chance to return from the reserve/PUP list in Week 11 before he becomes ineligible for the remainder of the season.

injuries.shortComment: Clark registered five tackles (three solo) and one interception during the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins in Week 9.
injuries.longComment: Clark jumped in front of a Malik Willis (abdomen) deep pass intended for Caleb Douglas early in the third quarter, which the Lions offense converted into a 33-yard field goal by Jake Bates eight plays later. It was Clark's second interception of the season and first since Week 1 against the Saints. The veteran safety is up to 49 tackles (28 solo), including 1.0 sacks, three pass defenses and one forced fumble through eight regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Saylors (neck) was a full participant at practice Wednesday.
injuries.longComment: Saylors sat out his first game of the season in Week 9 due to a neck injury, but it now looks like he's on track to return to game action in Week 10. With teammate Sione Vaki tending to an ankle issue, it appears possible Saylors could be called upon for a larger share of offensive snaps than usual versus the Patriots.

injuries.shortComment: The Lions acquired Cisco from the Jets on Monday in exchange for a 2029 sixth-round pick, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
injuries.longComment: Cisco will now suit up for his third NFL team after spending time with the Jaguars and Jets since entering the league in 2021. He had served mainly as a special-teams contributor over his final six games with Jacksonville, but Cisco should see more playing time on defense for a leaky Detroit secondary.

injuries.shortComment: The Lions moved Campbell (neck) to injured reserve Saturday.
injuries.longComment: Campbell suffered a neck injury while making a tackle in the third quarter of last Sunday's win over Minnesota and remains in the hospital. Detroit head coach Dan Campbell shared Friday that the linebacker continues to improve, but  his placement on IR means he'll miss at least the team's next four games. K.J. Britt, who Detroit signed off New England's practice squad Wednesday, may be asked to immediately step into a starting role.

injuries.shortComment: Rolder (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.
injuries.longComment: This move was anticipated, as Rolder suffered a season-ending hamstring injury in the Lions' win over Minnesota on Sunday. The rookie linebacker logged a career-high 17 defensive snaps and notched his first NFL sack in that contest, so his injury comes at an unfortunate time. Rolder will now turn his focus toward rehabbing the injury in order to be ready for offseason activities in 2027.

injuries.shortComment: McCreary (foot) is active for Sunday's game against the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: McCreary wasn't listed on the injury report Wednesday or Thursday but practiced in a limited capacity Friday. As a result, the 26-year-old was listed as questionable for the divisional showdown with Minnesota, though he has since been cleared to suit up. McCreary has appeared in all six of Detroit's regular-season games in 2026, amassing 22 total tackles (17 solo), 1.0 sacks and one forced fumble.

injuries.shortComment: Williams caught two passes for 27 yards on two targets in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: As he's been doing since making his season debut in Week 6, Williams operated as the Packers' third receiver against Minnesota. He logged 20 offensive snaps and ran 16 routes on 37 dropbacks. Williams has yet to hit 50 receiving yards in any of his five games this season and has no real fantasy appeal in 12-team fantasy leagues. He's well behind Matthew Golden, Christian Watson and Tucker Kraft in the order for touches and targets.

injuries.shortComment: Brooks rushed two times for one yard and caught his only target for two yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: It was Brooks' first action since Week 4 after spending five games on injured reserve with a high-ankle sprain. With Josh Jacobs (finger) inactive against Minnesota, Brooks led the backfield with 26 offensive snaps in Week 10, but it didn't translate to touches or opportunities to handle the football. With Kaleb Johnson and MarShawn Lloyd also involved, it's difficult to pinpoint any of these three as reliable fantasy options despite Jacobs' absence.

injuries.shortComment: Sturdivant caught two passes for 37 yards and a touchdown on four targets in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: After Green Bay was shut out in the first half, Sturdivant's first career touchdown came in the third quarter from 32 yards out, and it went down as the Packers' lone touchdown of the afternoon. Sturdivant played just nine offensive snaps as the fourth receiver and would need more than one injury ahead of him on the depth chart to be relevant in fantasy.

injuries.shortComment: Smack went 1-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made his only extra-point try during Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: Smack pushed a 53-yard field-goal try wide right in the first quarter before later converting a 40-yard attempt in the final seconds of the third quarter. The rookie has now gone 15-for-21 on field-goal tries, including 3-for-4 from 50-plus yards, while making 21 of 24 extra-point attempts over 10 contests so far during the 2026 campaign.

injuries.shortComment: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said that Zeitler had been in line to start at right guard in Sunday's loss to the Vikings before sustaining a triceps injury in practice Thursday, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: Since Zeitler signed a one-year deal Sept. 30, the Packers had been easing him back into game action after he didn't have a proper training camp. He got the chance to play his first extended snaps of the season in the Packers' Week 9 win over the Patriots, and after performing well, Zeitler was primed to draw his first start of the season in Week 10. However, the triceps injury as well as an ankle issue resulted in him sitting out Sunday, prompting the Packers to go with Lucas Glover at right guard. With Glover and the Green Bay offensive line struggling as a whole while the Vikings sacked quarterback Jordan Love eight times in Week 10, Zeitler should get the opportunity to start if he's healthy coming out of the team's Week 11 bye.

injuries.shortComment: Cisse (ribs) is "fine" after exiting the Packers' Week 10 loss to the Vikings early, Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Cisse did not return to Sunday's contest after exiting the game during the first quarter with a rib injury. Coach Matt LaFleur says the cornerback is "fine", and it appears Cisse will be set to return to practice after the Packers' Week 11 bye.

injuries.shortComment: Moore's ankle injury is not considered serious, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: The Packers' decision to rule Moore out with an ankle injury in the Week 10 loss to the Vikings was a precautionary move after the 26-year-old made his first appearance since returning from injured reserve. It's unclear if the fifth-year pro will be sidelined for any coming games, but Savion Williams and Matthew Golden will likely act as primary return options if Moore misses any time.

injuries.shortComment: Head coach Matt LaFleur acknowledged that Parsons (knee/illness) could be ready to make his season debut following the Packers' Week 11 bye, but he still has "a couple more hurdles" to clear before being deemed ready to play, Ryan Wood of USA Today reports.
injuries.longComment: Since opening Parsons' 21-day practice window Nov. 4, the Packers have seemingly targeted their Nov. 25 matchup with the Rams in Week 12 for the star pass rusher's 2026 debut. That plan doesn't appear to have changed while Parsons has been a limited participant in practice for the past two weeks, but he'll likely need to start practicing in full during Week 12 prep before the Packers give him the green light to play. If Parsons does in fact gain clearance to play against the Rams, he could be operating with a restricted snap count in what would mark his first game action since tearing his left ACL on Dec. 14, 2025.

injuries.shortComment: Taylor completed one of two pass attempts for three yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: Down 20 points with four minutes remaining in the fourth quarter and with starting quarterback Jordan Love having already taken eight sacks on the afternoon, the Packers opted to turn to Taylor to direct the offense for their final possession of the day. All three of Taylor's appearances on the season have now come late in blowout wins or losses, and his opportunities are likely to remain limited to garbage-time situations so long as Love is healthy.

injuries.shortComment: Lloyd finished Sunday's loss to Minnesota with 13 yards on four carries while catching all three of his targets for 26 yards.
injuries.longComment: With Josh Jacobs (finger) sidelined, Green Bay turned to the trio of Lloyd, Kaleb Johnson and Chris Brooks in the backfield. Johnson led the team with 10 carries and 42 total yards despite not getting any targets. Meanwhile, Lloyd turned his seven touches into 39 yards, and Brooks tallied just three yards on his three touches. Green Bay is on bye during the coming week, but Jacobs may still miss the team's next game, which will take place Wednesday, Nov. 25, against the Rams. If that's the case, Lloyd will likely work as part of a shared backfield again, which isn't great for his fantasy outlook.

injuries.shortComment: Johnson carried the ball 10 times for 42 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: The former Steeler led the Packers' backfield in totes and rushing yards, with MarShawn Lloyd chipping in 39 scrimmage yards on seven touches. Johnson has produced modest but decent numbers over the last two games, averaging a 4.6 YPC on 24 carries as the top early-down option for Green Bay. Josh Jacobs (finger) could return after the team's Week 11 bye, but if he isn't cleared, Johnson could find himself atop the depth chart again in Week 12 against the Rams.

injuries.shortComment: Kraft caught one of four targets for 19 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: The tight end's numbers reflected how much time his quarterback had to look downfield, as Jordan Love got sacked eight times in the rout. Kraft has been held to just one catch in back-to-back games, and he heads into a Week 11 bye with a 37-370-3 line on 56 targets through 10 games, with the Rams as the next opponent on the horizon in Week 12.

injuries.shortComment: Golden caught five of nine targets for 70 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: The second-year wideout was the only Packer to have much success on offense, leading the team in catches, targets and receiving yards. Golden has reached 70 yards in three straight games and five of the last six, and he heads into a Week 11 bye with a 58-853-5 line on 101 targets through 10 contests. His next chance to add to those numbers will come in Week 12 against the Rams.

injuries.shortComment: Watson caught three of five targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to Minnesota.
injuries.longComment: The Packers' passing game was stifled as the Vikings sacked Jordan Love eight times, giving him little time to find receivers like Watson. The 37 yards were a season low for the fifth-year wideout, while the three grabs tied for his lowest volume of 2026. Watson will take a 52-916-7 line on 79 targets through 10 contests into a Week 11 bye before facing the Rams in Week 12.

injuries.shortComment: Love completed 17 of 27 passes for 220 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: The 28-year-old QB came into the game having been sacked just 17 times in his first nine games of the season, but Minnesota brought Love down eight times Sunday. Despite that onslaught, he was able to find J. Michael Sturdivant for a 32-yard TD in the third quarter to salvage his line slightly. It was the first time since Week 6 that Love had failed to throw multiple touchdowns, and just the second time all season. He'll get a Week 11 bye to heal up from Sunday's pummeling before facing Myles Garrett and the Rams in Week 12.

injuries.shortComment: Melton (thigh) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Vikings, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Melton exited Sunday's game because of a thigh injury, and he will not be cleared to return to the contest. Skyy Moore (ankle) will also not return, so Savion Williams and Matthew Golden will operate as the top return options on kickoffs and punts.

injuries.shortComment: Glover (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Vikings, Mike Spofford of the Packers' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Glover's practice reps were limited during Week 10 prep due to a knee injury that prevented him from playing against the Patriots in Week 9. The third-year pro was cleared by medical staff to play Sunday, and he should reclaim his starting role at right guard from Laken Tomlinson.

injuries.shortComment: Van Ness (back) is active for Sunday's game against the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: Van Ness upgraded to limited in Friday's practice while dealing with a back injury. The weakside linebacker has recovered enough to suit up for Sunday's contest against a Vikings team that is also fighting for the NFC North title.

injuries.shortComment: Bullard (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: Bullard was upgraded to a limited participant in Friday's practice and is questionable ahead of Sunday's contest. The starting slot cornerback is all set to suit up, seemingly having overcome his ankle injury in time for a heavyweight NFC North bout with the Vikings.

injuries.shortComment: McKinney (foot) is active for Sunday's game against the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: McKinney sustained a foot injury during Friday's practice session. Despite the late-week injury, the star free safety is all set to suit up for Sunday's divisional contest. McKinney enters Week 10 with five interceptions, tying Amani Hooker for the league lead.

injuries.shortComment: Fairbairn converted his sole field-goal attempt and made all three PATs in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Fairbairn's 45-yard field goal came in the first quarter, before the Texans blew a 17-point lead. The kicker is now 19-for-20 on field-goal attempts and a perfect 24-for-24 on PATs through nine regular-season contests in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: Ogunbowale reverted to the Texans' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's official transaction log.
injuries.longComment: Ogunbowale was elevated to the active roster to operate as a depth option in the backfield behind Woody Marks (concussion) in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns. The running back rushed one time for two yards while reeling in his only target for 13 yards in the defeat. With Marks potentially sidelined with a concussion and David Montgomery (groin) uncertain for Week 11, Ogunbowale could be elevated again ahead of Thursday night's matchup with the Colts.

injuries.shortComment: Rutledge (neck) was a full participant in Monday's walkthrough practice.
injuries.longComment: Rutledge was unable to participate in any Week 10 prep sessions due to a neck injury. The starting left guard sat out Sunday's loss to the Browns due to the injury. Rutledge's estimated return to practice is a good sign for the first-round rookie's chances of playing in Thursday night's divisional showdown against the Colts.

injuries.shortComment: Teller (illness) was a full participant in Monday's walkthrough practice.
injuries.longComment: Teller was unable to suit up for Sunday's loss to the Browns due to an illness. The reserve right guard's estimated participation in Monday's walkthrough suggests the 31-year-old is likely over the Week 10 illness. As long as Teller can return to practice by Wednesday, he should be ready to suit up for Thursday night's AFC South contest against the Colts.

injuries.shortComment: Al-Shaair (groin) did not participate in Monday's walkthrough practice.
injuries.longComment: Al-Shaair was unable to play in Sunday's loss to the Browns due to a groin injury and personal matters. It was unclear which injury contributed more to the middle linebacker's inability to practice in Week 10, but Monday's walkthrough provides further insight. Al-Shaair is clearly still suffering from the groin injury, and his status for the Texans' Thursday night showdown with the Colts remains uncertain.

injuries.shortComment: questionable
injuries.longComment: questionable

injuries.shortComment: Marks (concussion) missed Monday's walkthrough.
injuries.longComment: Marks sustained a concussion during Sunday's loss in Cleveland, and head coach DeMeco Ryans said afterward that the running back isn't likely to gain clearance to play Thursday versus the Colts, according to DJ Bien-Aime of ESPN.com. The Texans may make a ruling on Marks' status as soon as they post Wednesday's injury report, and conversely position mate David Montgomery (groin) appears to be closing in on a return to action after logging a second full listing in a row going back to last week.

injuries.shortComment: Harrison (hamstring) was estimated as a non-participant on Monday's practice report.
injuries.longComment: After missing Sunday's loss to the Browns, Harrison opened the new week with another missed practice due to his hamstring issue. If he's unable to return in time for Thursday night's game against the Colts on a short week, Nico Collins, Xavier Hutchinson, Kayshon Boutte and Tank Dell likely will soak up the vast majority of the snaps at wideout.

injuries.shortComment: Montgomery (groin) was a full participant at Monday's walkthrough.
injuries.longComment: Montgomery was held out of Sunday's loss at Cleveland, which marked his fourth absence in a row due to a groin injury. Head coach DeMeco Ryans said afterward that he's "not certain" if Montgomery will be able to play Thursday against the Colts, per DJ Bien-Aime of ESPN.com. Montgomery's full session was his second straight going back to last week, and assuming he's trending toward a return to action this week, he's poised to take on a large workload considering fellow RB Woody Marks is in the concussion protocol and was a DNP on Monday.

injuries.shortComment: Schultz caught one pass for an 11-yard touchdown on two targets in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
injuries.longComment: While Schultz got into the end zone for the first time this campaign, his catches and targets were new single-game lows for 2026. Schultz has yet to produce more than 45 yards in a game when Nico Collins is healthy this season. The veteran tight end is a low-floor, TD-or-bust fantasy bet.

injuries.shortComment: Demercado rushed seven times for 16 yards and brought in one of two targets for minus-1 yard in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Demercado opened the game as a reserve in his second appearance in a Texans uniform, but Woody Marks' third-quarter exit due to a concussion left the former in the de facto No. 1 role. That still didn't lead to much opportunity for Demercado in a game during which Houston squandered a 17-0 first-half lead. However, DJ Bien-Aime of ESPN.com reports Marks is unlikely to play in Week 11 due to the short turnaround for a home matchup against the Colts, meaning Demercado and Dare Ogunbowale could have expanded roles in that game unless David Montgomery (groin) is able to suit up.

injuries.shortComment: Dell brought in three of four targets for 21 yards and rushed once for no gain in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: One week after posting a 105-yard effort against the Chargers in only his second game since 2024, Dell saw a big downturn in yardage Sunday. Nevertheless, the fact he retained a solid complementary role was encouraging, and the speedy wideout seems to be playing unencumbered by any physical or mental limitations following the recovery from his devastating knee injury. Dell will look to boost his yardage back up in a favorable Week 11 home matchup against the Colts on Thursday night.

injuries.shortComment: Hutchinson brought in four of nine targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Hutchinson, who was checked for a concussion during the fourth quarter, finished second across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets for the Texans. He also recorded a touchdown grab for the third straight game on an 11-yard catch early in the second quarter, and his receiving yardage tally was his highest since Week 5. Hutchinson now sports a 28-345-3 receiving line on 54 targets as he continues to function in a steady complementary role heading into a Week 11 home matchup against the Colts on Thursday night.

injuries.shortComment: Stroud completed 20 of 38 passes for 211 yards with three touchdowns and one interception while adding three rushes for 20 yards in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Stroud looked like he was on his way to another highly productive day early while helping stake the Texans to a 17-0 lead in the first half, but the fourth-year signal-caller and his offense largely stagnated in the second half. Stroud spread the ball around while connecting with eight different targets overall, and his trio of scoring strikes went to Nico Collins (12 yards), Xavier Hutchinson (11 yards) and Dalton Schultz (11 yards), the latter accounting for Houston's only second-half points. Despite the Texans' monumental collapse, Stroud's highly impressive season continues, as he's up to 2,462 passing yards, a 19:3 TD:INT and 120 rushing yards and another score heading into a favorable Week 11 home matchup against the Colts on Thursday night.

injuries.shortComment: Collins secured nine of 16 targets for 94 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Collins comfortably paced the Texans across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets, and he added his fifth touchdown of the season on a 12-yard catch in the first quarter. Collins also had a 16-yard reception on Houston's last-gasp drive wiped out by an offensive holding penalty, but he still finished with season highs in receptions and targets. Collins retains an unquestioned No. 1 role in the Texans' prolific air attack, affording him an enticing combination of floor and upside heading into a favorable Week 11 home matchup against the Colts on Thursday night.

injuries.shortComment: Smith (illness) is active for Sunday's game against the Browns.
injuries.longComment: Smith has recovered from Friday's illness enough to suit up for Sunday's contest. The reserve offensive tackle is one of the primary depth options behind starters Trent Brown and Aireontae Ersery.

injuries.shortComment: Anderson (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Browns.
injuries.longComment: The Texans' star pass rusher is all set to suit up for Sunday's showdown. Anderson has 9.5 sacks through eight games, entering Week 10 as the league leader. The Defensive Player of the Year candidate will look to continue to pressure his opponents after recovering from an ankle injury he sustained in Week 9 against the Chargers.

injuries.shortComment: Blankenship (concussion/hand) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Browns.
injuries.longComment: Blankenship ended Week 10 prep with back-to-back full practices, and he's progressed enough through the league's concussion protocol to be cleared to play Sunday. He is also working through a left hand injury that required surgery in October, but that won't prevent him from playing against Cleveland. Blankenship's return means M.J. Stewart will revert to a rotational role in the secondary.

injuries.shortComment: The Texans claimed Remigio off waivers from the Chiefs on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Remigio appeared in each of the Chiefs' first eight games of the regular season before being cut by the team Tuesday. He predominantly served on special teams as a returner on kickoffs and punts with Kansas City, and he figures to reprise that role in Houston, although he'll be competing for that role with Tremon Smith, Tank Dell, Woody Marks and Xavier Hutchinson.

injuries.shortComment: The Texans designated Smith (hamstring) to return from injured reserve Wednesday.
injuries.longComment: Smith landed on injured reserve in early October due to a hamstring injury. He's progressed enough in his recovery to return to practice and was a limited participant in Wednesday's session. Smith would need to be activated from IR in order to be available for Sunday's game against the Browns.

injuries.shortComment: Mills completed one of two pass attempts for seven yards and lost two yards on two carries in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Chargers.
injuries.longComment: Since the Texans had built their lead to 19 with less than five minutes remaining in the fourth quarter, head coach DeMeco Ryans opted to pull starting quarterback C.J. Stroud from the game and handed the offense over to Mills. In what marked his first playing time of the season, Mills directed two possessions. He led the Texans to a field goal with 2:20 remaining, then knelt twice to run out the clock when Houston got the ball back with 1:07 left. With Stroud enjoying a bounce-back campaign, Mills' opportunities will likely be limited to garbage-time situations if Stroud stays healthy.

injuries.shortComment: Stover was a healthy inactive for Sunday's 44-22 win over the Chargers.
injuries.longComment: Week 9 marked the first time all season that Stover sat out, with the Texans opting to keep their other four tight ends (Dalton Schultz, Foster Moreau, Brevin Jordan and Marlin Klein) active ahead of him. Through the Texans' first seven games, Stover had played less than half of the offensive snaps in each contest and recorded three receptions for 17 yards on five targets while rushing three times for five yards.

injuries.shortComment: Shrader made his sole field-goal attempt and converted all three PATs in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Shrader sole field-goal attempt was a 51-yard make in the third quarter of Sunday's contest. The kicker moves to 23-for-25 on field-goal attempts and 19-for-20 on PATs through 10 games of the 2026 regular season.

injuries.shortComment: Treadwell caught three passes on as many targets for 24 yards and a touchdown during Indianapolis' 24-22 win over Miami on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Week 10 was the Colts' first game without Josh Downs and Keenan Allen, who were traded to the Chiefs and 49ers, respectively, on Tuesday. Treadwell led all Colts wide receivers with three catches and 52 offensive snaps, and he connected with Daniel Jones for a seven-yard touchdown pass late in the second quarter to give Indianapolis a 14-7 halftime lead. It was the first time Treadwell found the end zone this season, and the 2016 first-rounder figures to maintain a larger role in the offense given the departure of the Colts' top targets at the trade deadline. The Colts will hit the road for Week 11 against the Texans on Thursday, and Houston's defense ranks 28th in the NFL in fantasy points allowed per game to opposing wide receivers.

injuries.shortComment: Giddens played two offensive snaps and didn't show up on the box score otherwise during the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Giddens barely saw the field during Sunday's win, and his two offensive snaps were well behind fellow running backs Jonathan Taylor (40) and Seth McGowan (17). Giddens -- a fifth-round pick of the Colts in the 2025 NFL Draft -- has seen little playing time since making his 2026 regular-season debut in Week 8 against the Jaguars. His role will likely stay minimal for Week 11 against the Texans on Thursday.

injuries.shortComment: Mallory (hamstring) did not participate in Monday's walkthrough practice.
injuries.longComment: Mallory suffered a hamstring injury during Week 10 prep, and he was not cleared to play in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. Indianapolis is operating on a short week, so Mallory faces an uphill battle to play against the Texans on Thursday.

injuries.shortComment: Gould (toe) was estimated as limited in Monday's walkthrough practice.
injuries.longComment: It's a new injury for Gould, who started Sunday against the Dolphins in the Colts' first game without both Josh Downs and Keenan Allen, who were both dealt at the trade deadline last week. Gould played 32 of 59 offensive snaps versus Miami and registered two catches for 28 yards on four targets.

injuries.shortComment: Colts head coach Shane Steichen reported Ward (shin) didn't return to Sunday's 24-22 win over the Dolphins and could miss Thursday's game versus Houston, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: Not only was Ward injured in Week 10, but Sauce Gardner (calf) was also ruled out before the end of the contest. With both Ward and Gardner in danger of missing Thursday's game against the Texans, Kenneth Harris and Kapena Gushiken could be in line for more snaps alongside Justin Walley.

injuries.shortComment: Colts head coach Shane Steichen reported Gardner suffered a left calf injury during Sunday's 24-22 win over the Dolphins and may not play Thursday versus Houston, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: Gardner did not return to Sunday's meeting with Miami and is now in danger of missing Thursday's game against the Texans. With Charvarius Ward (shin) also not a lock to suit up against Houston, there could be more snaps for Kenneth Harris and Kapena Gushiken alongside Justin Walley.

injuries.shortComment: McGowan rushed 12 times for 77 yards and a touchdown and returned two kickoffs for 61 yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: The rookie had shown well in recent weeks while trade speculation swirled around Jonathan Taylor, and even though the latter ultimately stayed put at the deadline, McGowan still compiled a new career high in rush attempts and rushing yards. The Kentucky product also followed up his first career rushing touchdown in Week 9 against the Cowboys with a four-yard scoring run early in the second quarter Sunday, and McGowan was also productive in his returner role. While Taylor should remain the de facto top backfield option for the Colts, McGowan should remain in an elevated role for what remains of Indianapolis' non-contending season.

injuries.shortComment: Jones completed 11 of 22 passes for 108 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions while adding five carries for nine yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.
injuries.longComment: Jones failed to eclipse the 200-yard mark for the fourth straight game while throwing multiple picks for the second time in that span. Neither turnover led to any Dolphins points, and Jones also threw a seven-yard touchdown pass to new interim No. 1 receiver Laquon Treadwell in the second quarter. Jones has completed just 59.6 percent of his passes and has a 7:12 TD:INT across 10 games, and with Indianapolis devoid of any realistic postseason aspirations, it may not be long before Anthony Richardson is given an opportunity under center. However, Joel A. Erickson of The Indy Star reports that head coach Shane Steichen has already named Jones the starter for Thursday's Week 11 road matchup against the Texans.

injuries.shortComment: Warren rushed once for three yards and brought in two of three targets for one yard in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: The new-look Colts offense was without Josh Downs and Keenan Allen after trade-deadline moves, but Warren was still surprisingly uninvolved. Daniel Jones completed only 50.0 percent of his passes and threw for just 108 yards, however, so Warren's minimal production is somewhat understandable in that context. Jones has thrown for under 200 yards in four consecutive games and is playing generally uninspired football, so Warren's fantasy outlook remains shaky for the time being but could improve if Anthony Richardson takes over under center at some point.

injuries.shortComment: Taylor rushed 16 times for 83 yards and brought in two of four targets for 20 yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Indianapolis.
injuries.longComment: Taylor made it through the trade deadline unscathed after rumors swirled around a possible change of scenery, but the talented back still split plenty of work with rookie backfield mate Seth McGowan, who logged 12 carries. Taylor still remained the No. 1 option and was the only one of the two to see any targets, and the rushing yardage total was his best since Week 7, just before serious trade speculation began. Taylor is staying put for the rest of the campaign, but it seems likely that he'll continue ceding a fair share of touches to McGowan moving forward.

injuries.shortComment: Raimann has entered the league's concussion protocol and has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Dolphins, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: Raimann took a hit to the head in the first quarter, and following tests by medical staff, the fifth-year offensive lineman has been diagnosed with a concussion. Luke Tenuta will stay in at left tackle for the rest of Sunday's game due to the absence of Raimann, who faces an uphill battle to play in the Colts' Week 11 tilt against the Texans on Thursday Night Football.

injuries.shortComment: The Colts placed Davis-Gaither (knee) on injured reserve Saturday.
injuries.longComment: Davis-Gaither was already ruled out for Sunday's game against Miami in what would be his second consecutive missed contest due to a knee injury. Now that he's been placed on IR, the seventh-year pro will be required to miss at least four games, so his next chance to play is Week 15 against the Titans on Sunday, Dec. 20.

injuries.shortComment: Key (hamstring) was activated from injured reserve Saturday and does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
injuries.longComment: Key missed the Colts' last five games while on injured reserve due to a hamstring injury that he sustained in Week 4 against the Commanders. He was cleared to return to practice Wednesday and logged a trio of full sessions, which gave the Colts the confidence to activate the veteran defensive lineman from IR ahead of Sunday's contest. Prior to his IR stint, Key posted eight tackles (three solo), including 0.5 sacks, and one forced fumble in four regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: The Colts placed Alie-Cox (groin) on injured reserve Saturday.
injuries.longComment: Alie-Cox was already ruled out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, and his groin injury is severe enough for him to warrant a stint on injured reserve. That means he'll be required to miss at least four games, and with the Colts on a bye for Week 13, that means the next time Alie-Cox can play is Week 15 against the Titans on Sunday, Dec. 20. Will Mallory (hamstring) has also been ruled out for Week 10, so Drew Ogletree and Pharaoh Brown will serve as the Colts' backup tight ends behind Tyler Warren against Miami.

injuries.shortComment: Haulcy (ankle) was a full participant at Thursday's practice.
injuries.longComment: Haulcy missed the Colts' Week 9 loss to Dallas due to an ankle injury and sat out practice Wednesday, but his return without limitations Thursday suggests the rookie third-round pick is ready to return to action. He's poised to reclaim the starting strong safety role Sunday against the Dolphins.

injuries.shortComment: Allen recorded 10 tackles (three solo) and a pass breakup in Sunday's 27-23 loss to the Cowboys.
injuries.longComment: With Akeem Davis-Gaither (knee) out versus Dallas, Allen played all 79 defensive snaps for Indy, marking the first time the second-round rookie has played 100 percent of the defensive snaps in a game. He's started back-to-back contests and is up to 25 tackles (nine solo), including 1.0 sacks, and the one pass breakup across six appearances this season.

injuries.shortComment: Boettcher recorded 12 tackles (four solo) in Sunday's 27-23 loss to the Cowboys.
injuries.longComment: With Akeem Davis-Gaither (knee) inactive against Dallas, Boettcher saw a spike in playing time alongside CJ Allen at linebacker for the Colts. The fourth-round rookie Boettcher played a season-high 73 percent of the defensive snaps and recorded his first career game with double-digit tackles.

injuries.shortComment: Wohler recorded 16 tackles (six solo) in Sunday's 27-23 loss to the Cowboys.
injuries.longComment: With A.J. Haulcy (ankle) inactive, Wohler made the spot start alongside Cam Bynum at safety for the Colts. Wohler played 98 percent of the defensive snaps against Dallas, easily a new career-high playing-time clip for the second-year safety after he missed his entire rookie season with a foot injury. Once Haulcy returns, Wohler will likely return to a reserve and special-teams role.

injuries.shortComment: Walley (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.
injuries.longComment: After being injured in Week 7, Walley has missed the past two games but appears ready to return to the lineup Sunday against the Dolphins. He's spent most of his time covering the slot for the Colts this season, recording 35 tackles (23 solo), including 1.0 sacks, and three pass breakups across seven appearances.

injuries.shortComment: Little went 4-for-4 on field-goal attempts and made all four of his PATs during Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
injuries.longComment: Little was able to make four field-goal tries for the second straight week, converting attempts from 46, 48, 36 and 40 yards in the contest. The kicker has now gone 18-for-20 on field-goal attempts, including 4-for-6 from 50-plus yards, over nine contests during the 2026 campaign.

injuries.shortComment: Hunter caught both of his targets for 16 yards, recorded a three-yard carry and contributed five tackles (three solo) and an interception during the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Fifty-six of Hunter's 62 snaps Sunday came on defense, and that's where he made his biggest impact with a diving interception on a Cam Ward pass intended for Elic Ayomanor, and the Jaguars offense converted that takeaway into a field goal 10 plays later. Hunter's impact on both sides of the ball has been undeniable: he has 28 catches (on 45 targets) for 298 yards and a touchdown, along with 36 tackles (24 solo) and seven pass defenses (including three interceptions) through nine regular-season games. The Jaguars will hit the road for Week 11 against the Giants on Nov. 22.

injuries.shortComment: Allen went without a carry or target while playing 12 of the Jaguars' 73 offensive snaps in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
injuries.longComment: As a rookie seventh-round pick last season, Allen carved out a fairly consistent role as a third-down specialist, but he's struggled to earn the same level of playing time in Year 2. With Bhayshul Tuten earning more trust on passing downs and with Chris Rodriguez and Ameer Abdullah also on hand as complementary options, Allen hasn't topped a 20 percent snap share in any of the Jaguars' first nine games. Altogether, Allen has logged just one carry (for one yard) to go with two receptions for nine yards on eight targets.

injuries.shortComment: Rodriguez rushed for five yards on four carries in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
injuries.longComment: Rodriguez was out-carried 26 to four by Bhayshul Tuten, who has very much proven himself as the Jaguars' clear RB1 in one of the league's best offenses. Tuten also out-snapped Rodriguez 52 to 10, while LeQuint Allen (12 snaps) saw more playing time. Rodriguez is little more than a deep-league bench stash should something happen to Tuten.

injuries.shortComment: Cameron caught all three of his targets for 67 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23, Week 10 win over Tennessee. He also returned five kickoffs for 142 yards.
injuries.longComment: Cameron gave the Jaguars a 14-point lead early in the fourth quarter when he hauled in a 25-yard touchdown pass from Trevor Lawrence. It was the rookie wideout's third touchdown of the campaign but his first since Week 3. Cameron's 67 receiving yards marked a career high, while his three receptions tied the most he's had as a pro. Cameron's propensity for finding the end zone (his three TDs have come on just 12 total catches) is appealing, but at this point he isn't getting enough volume to be a reliable week-to-week fantasy asset.

injuries.shortComment: Thomas caught three of four targets for 29 yards in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
injuries.longComment: The three catches tied his season high, while the four targets represented his biggest volume since Week 2. The Jaguars' decision not to deal Thomas at the trade deadline remains a curious one, as the third-year wideout simply doesn't have a significant role in Liam Coen's offense and might not step into one even if someone like Parker Washington got injured -- Josh Cameron was more productive Sunday on three targets and caught one of Trevor Lawrence's three TDs. Thomas will take a 13-146-2 line on 26 targets over nine games into a Week 11 tilt against the Giants.

injuries.shortComment: Meyers caught three of six targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
injuries.longComment: The six targets were second on the Jaguars behind Parker Washington's nine, but Meyers' longest gain of the day went for only 15 yards. The veteran wideout has also failed to find the end zone in six straight games, a stretch in which he's managed just a 19-256-0 line on 32 targets. Meyers will try to end that drought in a Week 11 clash against the Giants.

injuries.shortComment: Washington caught seven of nine targets for 152 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
injuries.longComment: The 152 receiving yards were a new career high for Washington, and the fourth-year WR highlighted his big day with a two-yard TD toss from Trevor Lawrence in the first quarter to open the scoring. It's Washington's second game this season with 100-plus yards, and he'll take a 36-645-6 line on 64 targets through nine contests into a Week 11 tilt against the Giants.

injuries.shortComment: Tuten carried the ball 26 times for 88 yards and a touchdown and caught three of four targets for 25 yards in Sunday's 40-23 win over Tennessee.
injuries.longComment: It's the second time this season that Tuten has reached triple-digit scrimmage yards in a game, with both those performances coming since the Jaguars' Week 7 bye. The second-year RB capped the rout with a six-yard TD run in the fourth quarter, extending his scoring streak to four games -- a stretch in which Tuten has racked up 260 rushing yards and three touchdowns on the ground while adding a 9-128-3 line on 10 targets through the air. He'll look to keep rolling in Week 11 against the Giants.

injuries.shortComment: Lawrence completed 25 of 35 passes for 352 yards and three touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans. He added 27 yards on four carries.
injuries.longComment: It was another huge performance from the 27-year-old QB, as Lawrence set a new season high in passing yards and threw at least three TDs for the fifth time in nine games to begin the year. He spread the ball around again, as seven different Jaguars caught multiple passes and Parker Washington, Josh Cameron and Brenton Strange were all on the other end of scores. Lawrence will take a sharp 21:5 TD:INT into a Week 11 clash with the Giants.

injuries.shortComment: Strange caught two of three targets for nine yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
injuries.longComment: The Jaguars keep blowing out their opponents, and Strange contributed a three-yard touchdown Sunday but was otherwise not heard from much, as Parker Washington dog-walked the Titans' secondary for 7-152-1 receiving on nine targets. Strange's touchdown grab was his first since Week 1. He remans a locked-in TE1 for fantasy, as he is playing virtually every snap in an elite offense.

injuries.shortComment: Hainsey (knee) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Titans.
injuries.longComment: Hainsey appeared to injure his knee while blocking on a run play in the third quarter, and he's being evaluated by medical staff to determine whether he can return to Sunday's contest. Jonah Monheim has taken over at center in Hainsey's absence.

injuries.shortComment: Striggow is being evaluated for a possible concussion and is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Titans.
injuries.longComment: Striggow has operated in a rotational role on the defensive line, so Bryan Thomas should see a bump in defensive snaps for as long as the former is out of the game.

injuries.shortComment: Green (forearm) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Titans, Michael DiRocco of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Green's 21-day practice window opened Nov. 11. The Jaguars' defensive end logged three consecutive full sessions in his return to practice but was ultimately deemed not ready to suit up for Week 10.

injuries.shortComment: Walker (ribs) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Titans, Michael DiRocco of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Walker played through a rib injury during the Jaguars' win over the Ravens in Week 9. The defensive end sat out Wednesday's practice session to nurse the issue before logging consecutive limited practices to end Week 10 prep. Walker is set to once again play through the nagging injury in Sunday's divisional showdown with the Titans.

injuries.shortComment: The Jaguars acquired Godchaux from the Saints on Monday in exchange for a 2028 sixth-round pick, though the selection could turn into a 2027 sixth-round pick if "conditions are met," Jonathan Jones of The Athletic of The Athletic reports.
injuries.longComment: Godchaux was selected by Miami in the fifth round of the 2017 NFL Draft. Since then, he has appeared in 145 regular-season games for the Dolphins, Patriots and Saints, garnering 487 total tackles (224 solo), 5.5 sacks and three forced fumbles. Godchaux's presence will bolster depth at the defensive tackle position for the Jaguars, especially with DaVon Hamilton (knee) done for the remainder of the 2026 campaign.

injuries.shortComment: Butker made all five PATs in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Butker did not attempt a field goal in the contest, as the Chiefs solely scored touchdowns. Butker now moves to 27-for-28 on PATs in 2026 as he continues to struggle to hold onto the starting kicker job.

injuries.shortComment: Gray caught one of three targets for six yards during Sunday's 35-13 win over the Falcons.
injuries.longComment: Gray was unable to reel in multiple passes for the second straight week after he had at least two catches in each of the team's previous five games prior to Week 9. The tight end did play a season-high 53 offensive snaps with Travis Kelce being limited to just 18 snaps on offense as a result of an ankle injury. If Kelce is forced to be limited or even miss the team's Week 11 matchup with Arizona, Gray would stand to operate as the team's primary tight end in his place.
